content.title: VUC029 | VUC029 delivery, practical assessment and credential rules
content.description: Course completion records study only. Certification also requires the separately controlled examination and applicable observed assessments specified in the program. This VNDRLY/U curriculum counterpart does not award, replace, or claim accreditation by the external credential issuer.

lessons.title: VUC029 delivery, practical assessment and credential rules
lessons.body: # VUC029 delivery, practical assessment and credential rules

lessons.title: Purpose, audience and boundaries
lessons.body:
## Purpose, audience and boundaries

Teach a prospective commercial driver to make safe decisions and demonstrate the actual vehicle skills for the selected class and modules. The complete materials edition includes all 24 domains and all endorsement modules; a learner's award must state which were actually completed. No state license, TSA approval, medical qualification, employer authorization, ELDT provider registration or Appendix F LCV qualification is issued by this document. Materials completeness does not mean any learner has passed.

Entry to moving-vehicle training requires valid legal authority, required medical status, qualified supervising instructor, roadworthy representative vehicle, insurance/site permissions and an approved safe route/range. Check state age/residency/eligibility/testing requirements individually. Do not teach public-road driving to an unauthorized learner. Use approved training occupants only; no revenue passengers, children or hazardous cargo in the exercises. Missing actual equipment means postpone that practical, not mark a tabletop exercise as physical proficiency.

Instructor: appropriately licensed and endorsed for the vehicle, experienced and competent in the taught operation, familiar with current rules and the exact equipment, and meeting applicable provider/state qualifications. A registered ELDT provider must separately satisfy Part 380, including curriculum, instructor/facility requirements, written assessment, proficiency determination, actual BTW-hour records, retention and registry reporting. VNDRLY has not asserted such registration. This guide is an instructional and evaluation package a properly qualified organization can use, not evidence that regulatory approval has occurred.

lessons.title: Planned teaching sequence
lessons.body:
## Planned teaching sequence

These are VNDRLY planning allocations, not federal minimums or a promise that all learners reach driving proficiency in a fixed time. Breaks/meals excluded; actual individual practice continues until demonstrated proficiency. Observation of another driver is not the learner's BTW time.

| Block | Domains | Planned teaching/practice allocation |
|---|---|---|
| Foundation and readiness | D01–D05 | 10 hours theory/workshop |
| Vehicle control and road decisions | D06–D11 | 12 hours theory/workshop |
| Records, cargo and incidents | D12–D14 | 6 hours theory/workshop |
| Passenger | D15–D16 | 4 hours theory/workshop |
| School bus | D17–D18 | 4 hours theory/workshop |
| Tank | D19 | 2 hours theory/workshop |
| Hazardous materials | D20–D22 | 6 hours theory/workshop |
| Multiple trailers and integration | D23–D24 | 4 hours theory/workshop |
| Core individual vehicle practice | P01–P12 | Initially schedule 24 hours; extend to proficiency |
| Passenger/school individual practice | P13–P18 | Initially schedule 12 hours; extend to proficiency |
| Tank, hazardous, multiple and integration workshops | P19–P24 | Initially schedule 8 hours; extend as needed |

Full-edition initial planning total 92 hours (48 + 24 + 12 + 8). Written examination time is additional: three 90-minute papers with breaks between. Some station preparation overlaps related instruction; do not double-count the same minutes as two attendance periods. A Class B learner uses a proper Class B vehicle; Class A uses a qualifying combination. A full all-module achievement requires actual relevant passenger/school and multiple-unit equipment, not a tractor-only demonstration. H endorsement federal ELDT is theory-only; the H workshops here are additional safe applied learning, not hazardous live-cargo requirements.

For each chapter: explain the mechanism, model its worked case, ask the two formative questions before revealing answers, discuss why unsafe choices fail, and require correction using a changed example. Record unresolved misconceptions and revisit them before final assessment. Use plain-language coaching, diagrams on a parked vehicle and accessible written formats. Do not lower a safety criterion or misrepresent state language/testing requirements as an accommodation.

lessons.title: Assessment and remediation
lessons.body:
## Assessment and remediation

The controlled final has 72 constructed responses, 3 per domain, scored 0/1/2: 2 fully correct safe response with required reason/calculation; 1 safe but incomplete; 0 wrong, absent or unsafe. Total 144, pass 116/144 (at least 80%) AND at least 4/6 in every domain included in the award. For the full edition all 24 domains are required. Papers: D01–08, D09–16, D17–24, each 24 questions/48 points; overall/domain rules govern, not compensation by an unrelated endorsement. Calculator and the supplied reference extracts are allowed for documented regulatory lookup; no key, coaching or public learning-check answers during the exam. Record which references were supplied. This is VNDRLY's exam, not a copy of a state examination.

Critical errors require correction and fresh reassessment regardless of score: choosing unauthorized operation; moving toward an unaccounted person; bypassing a failed brake/coupling/lift; falsifying hours/inspection; driving under an OOS order; entering uncleared rails; unsafe hazardous-material entry/transfer; releasing an unverified student; substituting theory for actual required driving. The assessor records the exact response and criterion, not just “unsafe.” All formative work must be corrected.

Practical scoring: each station has five observable criteria, 0 not demonstrated/unsafe, 1 safe but prompted/incomplete, 2 independent and correct. Require 8/10 AND every starred criterion 2. Every listed sub-maneuver must pass; a station average cannot conceal an omitted alley dock, lift or rail procedure. A safety intervention ends that attempt. Document correction, additional practice and a new attempt under changed conditions. Keep the original result. Protected reassessment cases cover every domain; do not let learners memorize and immediately repeat the same final answer as proof of transfer.

lessons.title: Safe setup and equipment
lessons.body:
## Safe setup and equipment

Provide actual representative inspected vehicles, manuals, keys under instructor control, chocks, cones, tape measure, pressure gauge, appropriate PPE, warning triangles, inert cargo/ratings, sample load and duty records, current regulation excerpts, ERG and shipping exercise. Use a passenger vehicle with accessible lift/securement for those competencies, a school bus with required equipment, approved tank trainer or secured actual empty clean tank equipment, and controlled multiple-trailer equipment for physical modules. Do not use dangerous cargo, children or unsuspecting public participants as training props. Establish weather limits, traffic separation, emergency contact, communication and stop command before movement.

Range: mark boundaries and maneuver spaces using the vehicle dimensions and current state/provider requirements; record measured dimensions on the station sheet. Maintain a clear exclusion area and escape space. No person stands in the projected vehicle path or between vehicle and obstacle. Actual manufacturer procedures are supplied at the station; do not invent a universal sequence for different couplers or lift models. Instructor approves route, public-road conditions and legal eligibility before departure. Maintain active two-way communication during actual driving. Do not create dangerous weather, skid, brake failure or collision for assessment.

lessons.title: P01 — Eligibility and dispatch gate (D01, D02, D24)
lessons.body:
## P01 — Eligibility and dispatch gate (D01, D02, D24)

Use three fictional cards: A has a Class B driver, 32,000-lb truck and 12,000-lb trailer; B has a Class A driver with an air-brake restriction and a full-air combination; C has the appropriate class and endorsements but an expired required medical qualification. Identify each mismatch and write the evidence needed for release. A needs the appropriate Class A authority; B needs compatible equipment or lawful restriction removal; C needs valid medical qualification.

Score: *holds all three; correct weight/class reasoning; restriction reasoning; medical/fitness distinction; accurate correction record. Discuss CLP occupancy and ELDT/state steps. Do not change any real driver record.

lessons.title: P02 — Controls and complete inspection (D03, D04)
lessons.body:
## P02 — Controls and complete inspection (D03, D04)

Use an actual secured vehicle, its manual, prior defect report and safe simulated defect cards. Never plant a dangerous mechanical defect for road use. Adjust seat, mirrors and belt; identify controls; inspect exterior, cab, safely accessible engine area, load/coupling and emergency equipment. Repeat at an enroute stop and after the trip.

Score: *safe securement and no contact with hot/moving/unsupported equipment; all inspection zones checked; correct controls/gauges; *holds the simulated unresolved brake defect; actionable written report. Record each component and condition, not merely a signature.

lessons.title: P03 — Brake systems (D05)
lessons.body:
## P03 — Brake systems (D05)

With the actual manual, chocks, clock and a level protected area, demonstrate then assess the vehicle-specific sequence. Record stabilized released/applied leakage, buildup/governor, warning and spring-control activation where applicable. Complete controlled parking/service tests. Hydraulic equipment needs its own procedure and cannot satisfy full-air performance.

Score: *vehicle secured during stationary tests; correct sequence and actual readings; correct limits; *failure recognized and held; controlled low-speed brake test. Record start/end pressure, elapsed time, warning/control pressure, manual criterion and disposition. No unqualified brake adjustment.

lessons.title: P04 — Range movement and shifting (D06)
lessons.body:
## P04 — Range movement and shifting (D06)

On a clear marked range, perform controlled starts/stops, centering and left/right turns, selecting proper gears/modes. Use the vehicle's reference points. Practice manual shifts only in an appropriate manual vehicle under qualified instruction.

Score: *belt and clear path; smooth start/stop; proper transmission operation; whole-vehicle swept path; *no contact or loss of control. Record each maneuver/configuration. An automatic vehicle does not demonstrate manual shifting.

lessons.title: P05 — Straight and offset backing (D07)
lessons.body:
## P05 — Straight and offset backing (D07)

Inspect the route, agree spotter signals, then perform straight backing and offsets to both sides. Allow safe pull-ups. The instructor safely removes the visible spotter from view to test stopping, without placing anyone behind the vehicle.

Score: *GOAL and exclusion area; all three maneuvers completed; smooth corrections/mirror scan; *immediate stop on lost spotter; final position within recorded boundaries. No reverse movement toward a person.

lessons.title: P06 — Alley and parallel backing (D07)
lessons.body:
## P06 — Alley and parallel backing (D07)

Set and record spaces appropriate to the actual vehicle and current state/provider requirements. Assess 45-degree and 90-degree alley backing, then sight-side and blind-side parallel parking. Use renewed inspection and pull-ups. Treat a cone as a real obstacle.

Score: *inspection for each setup; all four maneuvers completed; tractor swing and trailer tracking controlled; *stops for uncertain clearance; final position within boundaries without contact. Record all four results separately; all must pass.

lessons.title: P07 — Coupling and uncoupling (D08)
lessons.body:
## P07 — Coupling and uncoupling (D08)

On stable ground with actual tractor/trailer, manuals and qualified supervision, inspect, align, set height, couple and visually verify the mechanical lock. Perform the additional prescribed test, connect/test lines and stow gear. Then uncouple in the correct supported stages.

Score: *units secured and supported; actual manual sequence; *positive visual lock plus additional test; lines/brakes/lights/landing gear verified; stable completed uncoupling. Record coupler type and observed lock condition. Discussion alone does not pass.

lessons.title: P08 — Public-road control and communication (D06, D09)
lessons.body:
## P08 — Public-road control and communication (D06, D09)

Use an approved route with left/right turns, lane changes, curves, controlled-access entry/exit and safe stops. Maintain active instructor communication without distracting narration. Never stage a public hazard.

Score: *lawful signals/right-of-way; transmission/control; visual search/mirrors; speed and space appropriate to actual conditions; *safe continuous vehicle path. Record every route element. Arrange another route for an unavailable required element rather than checking it off.

lessons.title: P09 — Hazards, darkness and extreme conditions (D09, D10)
lessons.body:
## P09 — Hazards, darkness and extreme conditions (D09, D10)

During road instruction discuss a visible work zone or parked-route image, night visibility, fog/ice/wind, downgrade, blowout, skid/jackknife and off-road recovery. Use safe tabletop/video instruction where exposure would be dangerous. Demonstrate chain fitting only on an appropriate secured vehicle in a safe area.

Score: early hazard recognition; speed/space adaptation; *rejects unsafe continuation; sound emergency control/escape explanation; correct chain procedure/limits. Record discussion versus actual driving. This station cannot replace actual driving at P04–08; no real skid or blowout is required.

lessons.title: P10 — Rail, drawbridge and route decisions (D11)
lessons.body:
## P10 — Rail, drawbridge and route decisions (D11)

Plan for a fictional 12-ft-8-in vehicle facing a 12-ft-6-in restriction: reject the route. At an approved available crossing demonstrate applicable approach, stop, look/listen, gear and clearance procedures. If an actual crossing is not reasonably available for core instruction, record that fact and discuss it; required passenger/school performance must still be arranged safely. Simulate the blue-sign emergency call without calling a real emergency number.

Score: *rejects low clearance; lawful route/permit/weigh-station plan; *complete rail sequence; accurate crossing-ID call; correct drawbridge/inspection response. Record actual versus discussed work and any remaining module performance.

lessons.title: P11 — HOS and electronic/paper records (D12)
lessons.body:
## P11 — HOS and electronic/paper records (D12)

Supply a blank 24-hour grid and this fictional day: off 00: 00–05: 00, on 05: 00–06: 00, drive 06: 00–10: 00, on 10: 00–10: 30, drive 10: 30–14: 30, on 14: 30–15: 00, drive 15: 00–17: 00, off 17: 00–24: 00. Assume the preceding day supplied the rest needed for a qualifying ten-hour period. Total driving is ten hours, on-duty including driving twelve, and off-duty twelve. The ordinary fourteen-hour endpoint is 19: 00; the thirty-minute unloading interval qualifies as the non-driving interruption.

Now add six prior days totaling 54 on-duty hours under the 60/7 rule. The planned day cannot all support driving: the cycle reaches sixty after six more on-duty hours, at 11: 00 on this timeline, and further driving is prohibited. Later non-driving work does not authorize more driving. Demonstrate a truthful mock ELD correction and malfunction paper record, never a business-record edit.

Score: totals twenty-four hours; correct driving/on/off totals; window/break interpretation; *cycle limit applied before driving; *truthful records without invented personal conveyance.

lessons.title: P12 — Cargo and roadside incidents (D13, D14)
lessons.body:
## P12 — Cargo and roadside incidents (D13, D14)

Use an inert fictional 8,000-lb article and restraint-rating cards. Calculate 4,000 lb minimum qualifying aggregate WLL under the general rule, then check arrangement, count, condition and commodity requirements. A scale card shows an overloaded rear axle despite a legal gross total: hold it. Lay out triangles on a closed range for two-way and divided roads and conduct mock crash/OOS calls.

Score: weight/restraint reasoning; *holds axle overload; correct safe warning layout; *protects people without hazard entry; clear report and testing notification. Never deploy into live traffic for assessment.

lessons.title: P13 — Passenger inspection and accessibility (D15)
lessons.body:
## P13 — Passenger inspection and accessibility (D15)

Use an actual secured passenger vehicle with lift and approved mobility securement, its manuals and an adult volunteer or suitable inert trainer. Inspect bus-specific components, cycle the lift, check interlocks, and secure mobility equipment and the separate occupant restraint correctly.

Score: complete physical inspection; *safe actual lift use; correct device/occupant securement; respectful assistance/communication; *holds defects rather than bypassing. Record each interlock and exit checked. Watching someone else does not pass.

lessons.title: P14 — Passenger loading, luggage and briefing (D15)
lessons.body:
## P14 — Passenger loading, luggage and briefing (D15)

Adult roleplayers only. Choose a safe stop, secure the bus, load/unload, stow luggage, brief safety and respond to a mock disruption and medical-device question. An inert card marked unknown hazardous freight must not be accepted without resolution.

Score: *safe loading/door sequence; clear aisle/exits and secure baggage; complete briefing; calm management without driving distraction; *proper restricted-cargo and accessibility decisions. Check standee line and actual vehicle capacity.

lessons.title: P15 — Passenger evacuation, road and rail (D16)
lessons.body:
## P15 — Passenger evacuation, road and rail (D16)

Conduct a stationary evacuation drill with safe exits and an accessible assistance plan. Inject a headcount mismatch. Then observe actual passenger-vehicle road maneuvers and rail-crossing procedure on an approved route with a qualified instructor and only authorized training occupants.

Score: *safe exit and assembly decisions; accountability/missing-person report; security/breakdown judgment; *safe actual passenger-vehicle driving; correct actual rail procedure. Record separate observations. Required performance cannot be replaced by discussion.

lessons.title: P16 — School danger zones and stops (D17)
lessons.body:
## P16 — School danger zones and stops (D17)

Use an actual secured school bus, cones to demonstrate mirror coverage, and adult roleplayers, never children. Adjust all mirrors and identify blind areas. Execute the approved light/arm/door loading and unloading sequence, account for every rider and respond to a missing-child card by holding. Physically walk the bus after the route exercise.

Score: actual mirror coverage; correct stop/door sequence; *positive accounting before movement; *physical end-route check; appropriate stop-hazard/bullying reporting. A recorded child check without the walk fails.

lessons.title: P17 — School inspection and maneuvers (D18)
lessons.body:
## P17 — School inspection and maneuvers (D18)

Inspect school-specific equipment. On a closed range perform authorized backing and turns using actual tail-swing reference points. Before a new attempt the instructor changes an obstacle location. Discuss wind, strobe and security limits.

Score: full equipment inspection; correct reference points; *safe backing without a child spotter; *stops for changed clearance; safe weather/security decision. Actual equipment and maneuvers are required.

lessons.title: P18 — School evacuation and rail (D18)
lessons.body:
## P18 — School evacuation and rail (D18)

Conduct a stationary drill with adult roleplayers and an accessibility plan. Account for riders and control reunification using fictional identity cards. Demonstrate an actual school-bus rail procedure on an approved road with a qualified instructor. Simulate crash notification without contacting emergency services.

Score: *appropriate evacuation/exit choice; safe assistance/assembly; *headcount and controlled release; accurate crash communication; *actual rail sequence. Memorized speech does not replace operating the bus.

lessons.title: P19 — Tank planning and controls (D19)
lessons.body:
## P19 — Tank planning and controls (D19)

Use a safe clean empty tank trainer, its manual, and a water-only demonstration where approved. Locate and inspect closures, vents and emergency controls; draw the approved connection sequence. Calculate 2,000 gallons at 9.2 lb/gallon against an 18,000-lb payload allowance: 18,400 lb, so hold the 400-lb overload. Explain surge with a safe transparent trainer or video, never a rollover demonstration.

Score: component inspection; *correct capacity/weight decision; compatibility/fill/distribution reasoning; *safe shutdown sequence without release; sound driving plan. Record actual trainer operation. A tabletop-only attempt cannot be labeled physical transfer competence.

lessons.title: P20 — HM descriptions and placarding (D20)
lessons.body:
## P20 — HM descriptions and placarding (D20)

Use supplied current government sections and fictional cards: A is nonbulk Table 2 Class 3, 1,200-lb gross, no exception; B is a Table 1 material, twenty pounds; C has conflicting paper/package UN numbers. Locate the table and document decisions, shipping-description checks and paper storage.

Score: correct A decision; correct B decision; *holds C; correct description/emergency-information checks; accessible storage. A and B require placards on the stated facts. A real shipment also requires the actual material entry and applicable exceptions to be established.

lessons.title: P21 — HM segregation and transfer/security (D21)
lessons.body:
## P21 — HM segregation and transfer/security (D21)

Use current §177.848, inert package cards and unpressurized training controls. The instructor supplies two actual table classifications and their subsidiary hazards from the reference; the learner records the intersection/symbol, meaning and required separation. Repeat with an unidentified material: hold pending classification. Independently verify a mock destination change through trusted dispatch. Demonstrate shutdown on the safe trainer.

Score: recorded actual table lookup; *no guessed compatibility; *safe controls without interlock bypass; trusted security verification; proper passenger-cargo restriction decision. No dangerous cargo or public notifications.

lessons.title: P22 — HM ERG and incident reports (D22)
lessons.body:
## P22 — HM ERG and incident reports (D22)

Use the current ERG and government reporting extracts. Give a fictional identified material and a ninety-minute public evacuation, with no actual release. Locate its guide and applicable green-table/fire instructions, identify missing spill facts, then prepare a mock NRC call and DOT 5800.1 information worksheet. Unknown fields remain unknown.

Score: *safe withdrawal/no entry; correct ERG navigation; accurate location/facts/callback; immediate twelve-hour outer limit and thirty-day discovery rule; *no actual calls or invented facts. Also assess route, tire, fueling and attendance decisions. This is not a regulatory submission.

lessons.title: P23 — Multiple-trailer systems (D23)
lessons.body:
## P23 — Multiple-trailer systems (D23)

Use actual approved equipment on a closed range with manuals and a qualified instructor. Inspect, couple and uncouple correctly; verify every lock, line and valve and test rear-unit braking. Perform only authorized low-speed forward turns, not improvised backing. Explain the T/LCV boundary.

Score: *units and dolly secured; *all mechanical locks verified; full brake/air continuity; smooth path/clearance; correct qualification limit. Record every connection. A diagram cannot establish physical multiple-trailer proficiency.

lessons.title: P24 — Integrated dispatch and handover (D24)
lessons.body:
## P24 — Integrated dispatch and handover (D24)

Packet one has a valid license but an unresolved brake defect, unverified bridge, insufficient duty time and mismatched hazardous paper. List all holds, the responsible correction and objective release evidence. Packet two has all gates valid; explain a properly scoped approval without inventing credentials.

Score: *all failed gates found; correction/evidence for each; coherent route/time/load plan; accurate scoped handover; *no release before all failures resolved. This is a fictional decision exercise, not live dispatch.

lessons.title: Reusable forms and records
lessons.body:
## Reusable forms and records

**Learner plan: ** name/ID____ date____ class/configuration____ selected modules____ CLP/license/restrictions verified by____ medical/fitness verified by____ instructor credentials____ vehicle IDs____ accommodations____ remaining legal steps____.

**Attendance: ** date____ domain/station____ start/end____ breaks____ theory minutes____ individual range BTW minutes____ individual road BTW minutes____ observation minutes (separate)____ instructor____ learner____. Never count a simulator as actual BTW.

**Practical record — one per station and sub-maneuver: ** station____ vehicle/configuration____ manual/version____ location/conditions____ measured setup____ task/subtask____ five criterion scores____ starred criteria____ observed actions____ intervention____ result____ correction____ reassessment date/result____ assessor____ learner____. Blank fields are usable forms, not missing instructional content.

**Mock incident worksheet: ** occurrence/discovery times____ location/direction/crossing ID____ reporter/callback____ carrier____ shipping description/quantity/package____ injuries/admissions____ evacuation duration____ road closure____ continuing threat____ emergency contacts/times____ NRC criteria/notice____ written report due____ unknown facts____ retention/supplement review____. Use fictional data and do not submit it.

**Completion record: ** VUC029 version____ learner____ domains____ final/domain scores____ passed practicals/subtasks____ actual hours____ class/vehicles/modules____ restrictions/uncompleted work____ assessment date____ instructor____ reassessment history____. Use: “Completed the listed VNDRLY/U Commercial Driving learning and performance modules. Not a state CDL/endorsement, ELDT registry certification, LCV qualification or employer operating authorization.” Re-evaluate after a new vehicle/operation, demonstrated deficiency or applicable rule change. Do not invent an expiry interval; employer/state renewal requirements remain separate.


---

courses.title: VUC029 | Formative practice and explanations

content.title: VUC029 | Formative practice and explanations
content.description: Course completion records study only. Certification also requires the separately controlled examination and applicable observed assessments specified in the program. This VNDRLY/U curriculum counterpart does not award, replace, or claim accreditation by the external credential issuer.

lessons.title: Formative practice and explanations
lessons.body:
# Formative practice and explanations

Attempt each question before reading its answer. Correct mistakes by reviewing the named domain and solving a changed case with the instructor.

lessons.title: D01-L1
lessons.body:
## D01-L1

A trailer is empty. What weight information still affects licensing?

**Answer:** Its rating and the applicable greater actual/rated combination and towed-unit weights.

**Reason/remediation:** Empty does not remove rated weight; reconstruct D01 classification.

lessons.title: D01-L2
lessons.body:
## D01-L2

Does a VNDRLY course completion authorize state CDL issuance?

**Answer:** No; state testing/licensing and applicable registered-provider ELDT remain separate.

**Reason/remediation:** Separate material completion, learner achievement and legal authority.

lessons.title: D02-L1
lessons.body:
## D02-L1

What should a fatigued driver do despite remaining legal hours?

**Answer:** Stop safely, notify dispatch and obtain rest or relief.

**Reason/remediation:** Hours are ceilings, not evidence of alertness.

lessons.title: D02-L2
lessons.body:
## D02-L2

Why check a new nonprescription medicine before driving?

**Answer:** It can impair alertness; resolve safe use through appropriate medical guidance.

**Reason/remediation:** Legal sale does not establish fitness.

lessons.title: D03-L1
lessons.body:
## D03-L1

What do you do with persistent low oil pressure?

**Answer:** Secure and shut down per manual, report and obtain qualified correction.

**Reason/remediation:** Continued running can damage the engine; review warning response.

lessons.title: D03-L2
lessons.body:
## D03-L2

Does ABS remove the need for additional following space?

**Answer:** No; traction and stopping limits remain.

**Reason/remediation:** Assistance cannot defeat physics.

lessons.title: D04-L1
lessons.body:
## D04-L1

Give the minimum useful elements of a defect report.

**Answer:** Vehicle, component/location, observed condition, time and hold/notification disposition.

**Reason/remediation:** Specific reports support repair and safe release.

lessons.title: D04-L2
lessons.body:
## D04-L2

Why inspect enroute after an initially good inspection?

**Answer:** Loads, tires and equipment can change during travel.

**Reason/remediation:** Initial condition is not continuous assurance.

lessons.title: D05-L1
lessons.body:
## D05-L1

A combination loses 6 psi/minute on a stabilized applied test; disposition?

**Answer:** Hold and correct; it exceeds the typical 4 psi/minute criterion.

**Reason/remediation:** Check the actual configuration standard and do not average away failure.

lessons.title: D05-L2
lessons.body:
## D05-L2

Why select the downgrade gear before descent?

**Answer:** Avoid uncontrolled coasting/missed shifts and preserve braking capacity.

**Reason/remediation:** Review heat and fade.

lessons.title: D06-L1
lessons.body:
## D06-L1

Explain offtracking and tail swing.

**Answer:** Rear wheels follow inside the turn while rear overhang can swing outward.

**Reason/remediation:** Check both envelopes, not only tractor front.

lessons.title: D06-L2
lessons.body:
## D06-L2

How should an unfamiliar transmission be learned?

**Answer:** Secured orientation and supervised controlled practice using its manual before road use.

**Reason/remediation:** Do not discover controls in a hazard.

lessons.title: D07-L1
lessons.body:
## D07-L1

The spotter disappears during backing. Action?

**Answer:** Stop, secure as needed and restore an agreed safe visible position before moving.

**Reason/remediation:** Loss of communication removes the maneuver control.

lessons.title: D07-L2
lessons.body:
## D07-L2

Why is a pull-up appropriate?

**Answer:** It corrects alignment safely rather than continuing an uncertain blind path.

**Reason/remediation:** Accuracy never outranks clearance.

lessons.title: D08-L1
lessons.body:
## D08-L1

Why is a tug test alone insufficient?

**Answer:** It cannot prove proper jaw/kingpin engagement and absence of a high hook.

**Reason/remediation:** Visual lock verification and system checks are also necessary.

lessons.title: D08-L2
lessons.body:
## D08-L2

What ground matters when dropping a loaded trailer?

**Answer:** Stable, sufficiently supporting ground with correct landing-gear support and securement.

**Reason/remediation:** Soft ground can let a supported-looking trailer collapse.

lessons.title: D09-L1
lessons.body:
## D09-L1

Calculate the starting good-condition gap for a 60 ft combination above 40 mph.

**Answer:** About 7 seconds; increase for adverse conditions.

**Reason/remediation:** Six length seconds plus one speed second is a starting rule, not a guarantee.

lessons.title: D09-L2
lessons.body:
## D09-L2

Why is eye contact not permission to proceed?

**Answer:** The other person may not yield or understand; verify the actual path remains clear.

**Reason/remediation:** Communicate and observe rather than assume.

lessons.title: D10-L1
lessons.body:
## D10-L1

Why slow before a curve instead of braking hard in it?

**Answer:** Preserve traction and stability and avoid lateral/longitudinal demand combined.

**Reason/remediation:** Load and surface affect safe speed.

lessons.title: D10-L2
lessons.body:
## D10-L2

What is the first control response to a blowout?

**Answer:** Maintain firm steering, avoid abrupt braking and slow under control.

**Reason/remediation:** Sudden inputs can turn a tire failure into loss of control.

lessons.title: D11-L1
lessons.body:
## D11-L1

When may you enter a rail crossing?

**Answer:** Only after applicable stopping/look/listen requirements and full far-side clearance are satisfied.

**Reason/remediation:** A green roadway signal does not create train clearance.

lessons.title: D11-L2
lessons.body:
## D11-L2

What identifies a crossing to the railroad during an obstruction?

**Answer:** The emergency-notification sign information and crossing identifier.

**Reason/remediation:** Give a precise location from safety.

lessons.title: D12-L1
lessons.body:
## D12-L1

Property duty begins 06: 00 after qualifying rest. Does an ordinary 2 h meal move the 14 h endpoint?

**Answer:** No; the ordinary window still ends 20: 00.

**Reason/remediation:** Do not apply a split-sleeper exception without its conditions.

lessons.title: D12-L2
lessons.body:
## D12-L2

Does 30 minutes on-duty unloading interrupt the 8 h driving accumulation?

**Answer:** Yes if it is 30 consecutive minutes without driving under the ordinary property rule.

**Reason/remediation:** The break need not be off duty, but the time remains on duty.

lessons.title: D13-L1
lessons.body:
## D13-L1

Why can a legal gross load still be rejected?

**Answer:** An axle, tire, vehicle rating, securement or route limit can independently fail.

**Reason/remediation:** All applicable constraints must pass.

lessons.title: D13-L2
lessons.body:
## D13-L2

Is a tarp automatically a tiedown?

**Answer:** No; establish rated restraint function and applicable securement requirements.

**Reason/remediation:** Covering and restraint serve different purposes.

lessons.title: D14-L1
lessons.body:
## D14-L1

What should happen before photographing crash damage in traffic?

**Answer:** Secure/protect people and summon help; do not enter traffic for photos.

**Reason/remediation:** Evidence collection does not outrank life safety.

lessons.title: D14-L2
lessons.body:
## D14-L2

Does no visible injury end the post-accident testing inquiry?

**Answer:** No; notify the carrier and apply actual event/citation criteria promptly.

**Reason/remediation:** Some qualifying events do not depend on visible injury.

lessons.title: D15-L1
lessons.body:
## D15-L1

Why are wheelchair brakes insufficient for transport?

**Answer:** They do not replace approved mobility-device securement and separate occupant restraint.

**Reason/remediation:** Use actual rated equipment and procedures.

lessons.title: D15-L2
lessons.body:
## D15-L2

List key passenger briefing subjects.

**Answer:** Belts, exits, emergency contact, extinguisher and safe aisle/restroom procedures as equipped.

**Reason/remediation:** Brief before motion and confirm comprehension.

lessons.title: D16-L1
lessons.body:
## D16-L1

Must every bus breakdown cause immediate evacuation?

**Answer:** No; compare cabin and outside hazards and maintain supervision, changing the decision if danger develops.

**Reason/remediation:** Evacuation is a hazard decision.

lessons.title: D16-L2
lessons.body:
## D16-L2

What follows movement to an assembly point?

**Answer:** Account for everyone, report missing persons and prevent reentry.

**Reason/remediation:** Leaving the bus does not complete evacuation management.

lessons.title: D17-L1
lessons.body:
## D17-L1

A child drops an item near a bus wheel. What do you do?

**Answer:** Keep the bus secured, prevent unsafe retrieval and positively clear the danger zone.

**Reason/remediation:** A mirror glance alone cannot account for a hidden child.

lessons.title: D17-L2
lessons.body:
## D17-L2

What completes the route child check?

**Answer:** A physical walk-through including seats/under seats and required documentation.

**Reason/remediation:** An electronic reminder does not inspect the bus.

lessons.title: D18-L1
lessons.body:
## D18-L1

Who may serve as a school-bus backing spotter?

**Answer:** An appropriate trained person under the approved procedure, never a student placed behind the bus.

**Reason/remediation:** Keep children out of vehicle movement hazards.

lessons.title: D18-L2
lessons.body:
## D18-L2

Why brief field-trip passengers on evacuation?

**Answer:** They may not know the regular route routines or exits.

**Reason/remediation:** Familiarity cannot be presumed.

lessons.title: D19-L1
lessons.body:
## D19-L1

Compute 3,000 gal at 8.5 lb/gal.

**Answer:** 25,500 lb before vehicle/tank and other load weight.

**Reason/remediation:** Keep volume and mass units distinct.

lessons.title: D19-L2
lessons.body:
## D19-L2

Do baffles eliminate tank rollover risk?

**Answer:** No; side forces, high center of gravity, surge and driving inputs remain.

**Reason/remediation:** Reduce speed before turns.

lessons.title: D20-L1
lessons.body:
## D20-L1

Put a basic shipping description in order.

**Answer:** Identification number, proper shipping name, class/division, packing group when applicable.

**Reason/remediation:** Check additional required entries rather than treating the sequence as the whole paper.

lessons.title: D20-L2
lessons.body:
## D20-L2

Can the 1,001 lb Table 2 threshold excuse Table 1 placards?

**Answer:** No; apply the correct table, bulk rules and exceptions to the actual shipment.

**Reason/remediation:** One threshold is not universal.

lessons.title: D21-L1
lessons.body:
## D21-L1

What do you do with incompatible or uncertain mixed freight?

**Answer:** Hold loading and resolve the actual segregation requirements with qualified personnel.

**Reason/remediation:** An improvised gap does not establish compliance.

lessons.title: D21-L2
lessons.body:
## D21-L2

An unknown caller changes a hazardous-load destination. Response?

**Answer:** Independently verify through trusted dispatch channels before diverting.

**Reason/remediation:** Protect custody and avoid social engineering.

lessons.title: D22-L1
lessons.body:
## D22-L1

What is the driver priority at an unknown release?

**Answer:** Withdraw, warn, request emergency help and provide verified shipping information from safety.

**Reason/remediation:** No unqualified leak entry or rescue.

lessons.title: D22-L2
lessons.body:
## D22-L2

How do NRC and written report timing differ?

**Answer:** Specified immediate reports as soon as practical no later than 12 h; applicable written report within 30 days of discovery.

**Reason/remediation:** Driver emergency notification is immediate, not delayed to either deadline.

lessons.title: D23-L1
lessons.body:
## D23-L1

Why test brakes on every trailer?

**Answer:** Normal tractor pressure does not establish air/control continuity to rear units.

**Reason/remediation:** A disconnected or closed line can leave a trailer without proper braking.

lessons.title: D23-L2
lessons.body:
## D23-L2

Does T alone establish LCV qualification?

**Answer:** No; applicable separate Part 380 LCV training and route/configuration authority remain.

**Reason/remediation:** Do not convert an endorsement into every operational qualification.

lessons.title: D24-L1
lessons.body:
## D24-L1

Name independent dispatch checks that can stop a trip.

**Answer:** Driver fitness/authority, vehicle, load/passengers, route, duty time and documents.

**Reason/remediation:** One passing check cannot compensate for another failed gate.

lessons.title: D24-L2
lessons.body:
## D24-L2

What must a completion record identify?

**Answer:** Actual modules, vehicle/class, theory/practical evidence, hours and remaining legal steps.

**Reason/remediation:** Scope the claim to demonstrated work.


---

lessons.title: Review method and limits
lessons.body:
## Review method and limits

Author checked numeric examples, question/domain mapping, paper separation, critical practical gates and federal source-unit coverage. This is an author review, not an independent regulator or accredited-provider audit. No physical driving, external examination, learner achievement, field qualification, deployment or publication is claimed. Source dates and state administrative conditions can change; before delivery the qualified provider rechecks applicable rules and actual vehicle instructions. That normal delivery duty does not replace the written instruction or mark an unperformed learner task complete.
