lessons.title: VUC043 foundation practice
lessons.body:
# VUC043 foundation practice

These original foundation record stations are supplemented by mandatory physical demonstrations P27/P28/P31. Overall completion and scoring are governed by delivery-and-practicals.md.

lessons.title: Teaching sequence
lessons.body:
## Teaching sequence

Chapters1–7 establish the evidence basis;8–13 explain thermal/metallurgical control;14–18 address imperfections, materials and treatments;19–24 connect examination to repair, safety and release. Teach each worked example, then issue its changed case without showing the response. Do not reward a student for guessing a code number or an acceptance threshold that is not supplied. Reward a correct calculation and an honest limit on what it establishes.

lessons.title: Station rubric and records
lessons.body:
## Station rubric and records

Each station has five criteria,0–2 each: accurate facts/identity; correct technical interpretation; appropriate calculation or method; bounded disposition/authority; traceable communication.2 means correct with reason,1 safe but incomplete,0 incorrect/missing/unsafe. Pass8/10. Unsupported release, falsifying evidence, inventing code limits or unsafe intervention is critical and requires correction and changed reassessment regardless of total. Each station specifies the expected evidence below.

Record learner, date, assessor, program version, source record/revision, five scores, critical finding, feedback, changed response and outcome. Accept equivalent correct reasoning and document why. Keep original attempts rather than replacing them with a later pass.

lessons.title: P01 — Governing-basis audit
lessons.body:
## P01 — Governing-basis audit

UseQ01. Record: drawing revision4, WPS tied to revision2, inspection plan without an edition. Expected: identify three distinct basis questions, hold dependent acceptance, route technical resolution and continue independent safe checks. Changed: drawing4 is confirmed but WPS support remains unresolved. Deliverable: controlled-document discrepancy sheet.

lessons.title: P02 — Geometry and local criteria
lessons.body:
## P02 — Geometry and local criteria

UseW01. Expected:7.94 mm average does not clear7.4 local result; nominal throat5.657 mm; overlap separate; uncertainty handled. Changed:7.6±0.2 corrected measurement. Deliverable: mapped measurements and disposition. Optional inert gauge demonstration does not substitute for the written reasoning.

lessons.title: P03 — Material chain
lessons.body:
## P03 — Material chain

UseQ03. Record: three cut pieces, two traceable marks and one unmarked piece; only one certificate fits the unmarked piece's apparent size. Expected: no identity by resemblance, chemistry/property distinction, approved reconciliation. Changed: chemistry result arrives but no heat linkage. Deliverable: piece-to-certificate map with unknowns retained.

lessons.title: P04 — Process sequence review
lessons.body:
## P04 — Process sequence review

UseQ04. Record: GTAW root/SMAW fill approved; FCAW root proposed; wire certificate supplied. Expected: process is not established by wire identity, separate personnel and procedure review, actual deposited regions tracked. Changed: process unchanged but transfer mode changes. Deliverable: change-review request.

lessons.title: P05 — Qualification support matrix
lessons.body:
## P05 — Qualification support matrix

UseW02. Expected: WPS range exceeds support, production15 mm exceeds14, root3 fits original but not changed2.5 maximum, backing/process changes independent. Deliverable: requirement/record/production table for every supplied variable.

lessons.title: P06 — Consumable disposition
lessons.body:
## P06 — Consumable disposition

UseW03. Expected: distinguish identity and condition, segregate uncertain batch, link affected welds and avoid invented rebaking. Changed: correct certificate without issue linkage. Deliverable: batch/weld trace and nonconformance record.

lessons.title: P07 — Fit-up hold point
lessons.body:
## P07 — Fit-up hold point

UseW04. Expected: gap and mismatch deviations identified by quadrant, cracked tack kept separate, no backdated examination. Changed: geometry corrected but tack examination missing. Deliverable: fit-up inspection record with exact locations.

lessons.title: P08 — Temperature measurement validity
lessons.body:
## P08 — Temperature measurement validity

UseW04 andQ08. Expected: minimum and maximum interpreted independently, correct location/time required,5°C low/8°C high identified. Changed: values correct but location wrong. Deliverable: thermal observation log and affected-work disposition request.

lessons.title: P09 — Energy calculation
lessons.body:
## P09 — Energy calculation

UseW05. Expected:1.0/2.0 arc energies,0.8/1.6 illustrative net, correct comparison,1.2 arithmetic for changed record with waveform limitation. Deliverable: units and convention explicitly shown.

lessons.title: P10 — Production-record correction
lessons.body:
## P10 — Production-record correction

UseQ10. Record: one actual travel-speed observation differs from repeated target entries. Expected: preserve original, define affected segment, do not treat future correction as past validation. Changed: only one pass witnessed. Deliverable: corrected bounded observation statement.

lessons.title: P11 — Property evidence
lessons.body:
## P11 — Property evidence

UseQ11 andW07. Expected: tensile, hardness, impact and chemistry answer different questions; a pass in one does not override another required failure. Changed: valid hardness added while impact fails. Deliverable: property-to-test evidence table.

lessons.title: P12 — Delayed examination schedule
lessons.body:
## P12 — Delayed examination schedule

UseQ12. Expected:Tuesday14:00 toWednesday09:00 is19 hours, five short of supplied24; later waiting is not later examination. Changed: required36 hours, actual30. Deliverable: schedule correction preserving actual timestamps.

lessons.title: P13 — Cracking-cause comparison
lessons.body:
## P13 — Cracking-cause comparison

UseQ13. Records: weld-center crack during cooling, parent-plate separation in tee, indication after heat treatment. Expected: distinct candidates, chronology/material evidence, no universal diagnosis from appearance. Changed: new timing record. Deliverable: cause/evidence/repair-review matrix.

lessons.title: P14 — Imperfection interpretation
lessons.body:
## P14 — Imperfection interpretation

UseQ14. Records: rounded RT findings, suspected sidewall fusion, intentionally partial-penetration drawing. Expected: distinguish types and design intent, examine method capability, use actual criteria. Changed: smooth cap after dressing. Deliverable: defensible examination request.

lessons.title: P15 — Profile and distortion
lessons.body:
## P15 — Profile and distortion

UseQ15 andW01. Expected: size/profile/alignment independent, heat straightening requires approval, overlap removal may reduce size. Changed: size drops below minimum after dressing. Deliverable: linked nonconformance record.

lessons.title: P16 — Stainless and dissimilar controls
lessons.body:
## P16 — Stainless and dissimilar controls

UseQ16. Record: correct duplex filler with excessive interpass; proposed stronger dissimilar filler. Expected: thermal/property concern remains, strength alone insufficient, qualified metallurgy/procedure review. Changed: cap appearance acceptable. Deliverable: bounded acceptance statement.

lessons.title: P17 — Specialized joining boundary
lessons.body:
## P17 — Specialized joining boundary

UseQ17. Record: titanium repair copied from steel process; brazed joint proposed for fusion-weld design. Expected: material-specific contamination/qualification review, leak test not universal acceptance. Changed: successful leakage result. Deliverable: substitution review with responsible authority.

lessons.title: P18 — PWHT chart reconstruction
lessons.body:
## P18 — PWHT chart reconstruction

UseW06. Expected:45-minute simultaneous overlap,15 short,TC2 location gap, no unapproved45+30 accumulation. Deliverable: timeline and exact open conditions.

lessons.title: P19 — Visual measurement claim
lessons.body:
## P19 — Visual measurement claim

UseQ19. Record: perspective photo and one gauge reading on200 mm weld. Expected: location-specific evidence, instrument suitability, scale/perspective limits, appropriate coverage request. Changed: post-use damaged gauge discovered. Deliverable: affected-data review and remeasurement plan.

lessons.title: P20 — NDE method/coverage selection
lessons.body:
## P20 — NDE method/coverage selection

UseQ20 andW08. Expected: PT/MT/RT/UT limitations, surface versus internal questions, no claim that one method finds everything. Changed: surface gap closes while volumetric gap persists. Deliverable: method-to-question table and residual uncertainty.

lessons.title: P21 — Test packet audit
lessons.body:
## P21 — Test packet audit

UseW07. Expected:530 MPa, impact26.667/min19 failure and identity conflict, bend3.4 failure; changed impact28/min25 passes only its scope. Deliverable: calculation and separate test dispositions.

lessons.title: P22 — Repair history
lessons.body:
## P22 — Repair history

UseW08. Expected: missed excavation hold preserved, repair cause/sequence tracked, final visual/leak result not retroactive witness. Changed: final RT satisfactory. Deliverable: repair chronology and open requirements.

lessons.title: P23 — Safe inspection decision
lessons.body:
## P23 — Safe inspection decision

UseQ23. Record: drained vessel, old permit, unverified isolation; later fume-control failure. Expected: no access from old permit alone, current site controls, withdraw/stop under procedure when controls fail, no improvised rescue. Deliverable: task-boundary statement and interrupted-inspection record.

lessons.title: P24 — Release dossier
lessons.body:
## P24 — Release dossier

UseI43. Expected: four separate joint dispositions with owners and no blanket release; changed packet closes only supported facts. Deliverable: joint sheets plus management summary. Also score the integrated20-point rubric independently.

lessons.title: Blank reusable forms
lessons.body:
## Blank reusable forms

**Inspection observation:** project___ asset/joint___ drawing/revision___ WPS/revision___ stage/time___ requirement/source___ actual value/condition___ instrument/method___ location/coverage___ limitation___ pass/hold/nonconformance___ observer___ next owner/date___.

**Qualification applicability:** production variable___ required value___ supporting record/revision___ supported range/basis___ evidence link___ fits/does not fit/unknown___ approving role___ resolution___. Repeat for all applicable variables; a blank is not a pass.

**Nonconformance:** identifier___ requirement___ observed deviation___ affected welds/segments___ immediate containment___ authorized disposition___ corrective work___ required re-examination___ actual verification___ residual limits___ approver/date___. Retain prior records.

courses.title: VUC043 | VUC043 delivery and qualification rules

content.title: VUC043 | VUC043 delivery and qualification rules
content.description: Course completion records study only. Certification also requires the separately controlled examination and applicable observed assessments specified in the program. This VNDRLY/U curriculum counterpart does not award, replace, or claim accreditation by the external credential issuer.

lessons.title: VUC043 delivery and qualification rules
lessons.body: # VUC043 delivery and qualification rules

lessons.title: Program definition
lessons.body:
## Program definition

Audience: prospective welding inspectors and quality personnel who need instruction in welding fundamentals, metallurgy, production evidence, visual measurement and specification navigation. Prerequisites: basic industrial safety, arithmetic and drawing literacy. Instructor diagnoses these with the supplied geometry/material records and provides necessary teaching. This program does not replace AWS's documented experience, vision or examinations and does not predict an external exam pass.

Outcome: accurately identify inspection basis, trace material/process records, recognize metallurgical/production issues, interpret supplied tests, use benign visual gauges, read the supplied drawing/specification and communicate a bounded decision. Instructor/assessor needs welding-inspection and measurement competence; use qualified specialists for issues outside competence. Employer authorization, live welding/NDT and actual code-based acceptance are separate.

lessons.title: Planned64-hour sequence
lessons.body:
## Planned64-hour sequence

| Block | Hours | Required evidence |
|---|---:|---|
| Q01–Q32, eight metallurgy clinics and64 checks |16| Individual corrected reasoning and changed examples |
| W01–W12 |18| Worked records, calculations, W12 actual observed examination |
| P01–P32 |16| Individual records; P27/P28/P31 observed instrument work |
| I43 and I43-B |4| Two independent integrated dispositions |
| Targeted remediation/readiness |6| Corrected gaps, more time if needed |
| Controlled final |4|32 cases/96 decisions |

Planned hours are not actual attendance. Breaks/additional instruction are separate. The verified original VUC039 foundation has been copied into this package so learners need not locate another program. Its materials-only limitations remain; VUC043 adds its own mandatory instrument practice and specification work. Reuse does not imply external credential equivalence.

lessons.title: Equipment and actual demonstration
lessons.body:
## Equipment and actual demonstration

Provide course/records, calculator, stable inert weld replicas of known geometry, fillet/profile gauge and ruler/caliper suitable for the replicas, adequate illumination, safe cleaning cloths and assessor reference sheets. No hot/sharp/live specimens, powered welding, radiography, chemicals or confined-space access. Assessor records specimen IDs, reference values, uncertainty/tolerance and instrument status before use. Use original benign replicas rather than unauthorized copies of proprietary examination specimens.

P27/P28/P31 and W12 require observed individual performance. Learner verifies identity/basis/tool condition, obtains correct contact, reads/records units and locations, repeats measurement, interprets supplied limits and reports inaccessible areas. Remote equivalents require observed safe setup and known references. If unavailable, mark practical outcomes pending; do not award the learner credential from quiz answers alone. Accessible instruments/communication and extra time may be provided without eliminating the outcome or coaching answers.

Foundation P01–P24 in foundation-stations.md remain required record tasks. Their optional demonstration comments do not waive the additional mandatory tasks here. Scoring for every station is five dimensions0–2: evidence/identity, technique or reasoning, measurement/calculation, bounded disposition and traceable reporting. Pass8/10 with no zero and no unresolved critical error. Fabricated evidence, unsupported release, invented code thresholds and unsafe intervention are critical.

lessons.title: P25 — Credential and actual examination conditions
lessons.body:
## P25 — Credential and actual examination conditions

Use Q25. Learner separates external qualification, employer appointment and actual visibility. Change valid paperwork to inadequate lighting. Expected: resolve physical conditions without inventing a pass; no claim of AWS status from this package.

lessons.title: P26 — Draw the weld requirement
lessons.body:
## P26 — Draw the weld requirement

Use W09. Learner sketches four specified sideA segments and labels160 mm deposited length,60 mm gaps and340 mm span. Add other-side changed instruction; expected320 mm total and390 mm farthest extent, not assumed weld sequence.

lessons.title: P27 — Demonstrate gauge technique
lessons.body:
## P27 — Demonstrate gauge technique

On inert known replica, learner verifies tool/reference, makes correct contact and repeats measurements. Assessor introduces benign contact interference. Expected: recognize/recheck reference and document correction rather than force the gauge. Score actual technique against recorded reference/tolerance. No recorded actual performance means pending, not pass.

lessons.title: P28 — Demonstrate repeatability and uncertainty reasoning
lessons.body:
## P28 — Demonstrate repeatability and uncertainty reasoning

Learner measures a benign feature twice with checked tool, records resolution/units and compares with assessor's reference. Then interpret W10 A/B/C intervals and improved A result. Expected: indeterminate/pass/fail distinction under the explicitly supplied rule, no extra-decimal accuracy claim. Both technique and written interpretation must pass.

lessons.title: P29 — Navigate S43
lessons.body:
## P29 — Navigate S43

Use W11. Learner finds scope, base limit, exception, addendum precedence and release clause, cites them for J1–J4 and explains each independent issue. Changed results close only valid corrected facts. This assesses navigation method, not unseen external code knowledge.

lessons.title: P30 — Describe before classifying
lessons.body:
## P30 — Describe before classifying

Use a benign drawing/photo description of uncertain toe line and S43.7. Learner records actual feature/location, method limits and designated review need. Changed qualified disposition identifies nonrelevant mark; update label with evidence, do not preserve an unsupported crack claim.

lessons.title: P31 — Complete observed visual examination
lessons.body:
## P31 — Complete observed visual examination

Perform W12 sequence on a changed inert replica. Learner maps all accessible stations, measures, applies S43 and reports obscured region honestly. Assessor observes systematic coverage and instrument work. A copied neighbor value or false coverage claim is critical regardless of numerical score.

lessons.title: P32 — Defend the disposition
lessons.body:
## P32 — Defend the disposition

Use I43-B. Learner gives two-minute owner briefing and evidence matrix, separating geometry, material, WPS and NDT issues. Change valid NDT and identity facts only; retain unresolved toe-line issue. Assess technically sound reasoning, not exact phrasing.

lessons.title: Final and learner completion
lessons.body:
## Final and learner completion

Require all64 formative checks corrected, eight clinics passed under their rules, all12 workshops8/10, all32 stations8/10 with no zero, and both integrated cases16/20 with minimum2/4 in each dimension and no unresolved critical error. W12 and named observed stations must actually be demonstrated. A learning record must not imply that authoring this package completed any person's assessment.

Final32 original cases×3 decisions×2=192 maximum;240 minutes; pass154/192 and4/6 in each domain, with no unresolved critical error. Calculator/coursebook allowed; protected keys, collaboration and outside assistance prohibited. These VNDRLY rules are separate from AWS examinations. Score2 correct/supported,1 safe/incomplete,0 incorrect/missing/unsafe; accept equivalent sound reasoning.

Remediate failed outcomes using chapter/workbook and changed cases; preserve original response and score. Issue changed private prompts without keys. Repeat the actual instrument task when the failure concerns technique. After two unsuccessful reassessments provide individualized teaching and a fresh equivalent supervised assessment. Allow documented appeal and another competent assessor where feasible. Do not award for attendance or average away a critical error.

Record learner identity, version/hash, actual dates/hours, check/lab/station evidence, reference measurements, integrated cases, final scores, remediation, accommodations, appeals and completion authority. Keep private keys restricted under organizational access policy; separate files alone are not enforced access control. The copied foundation forms and W12 records supply the actual recording fields.

Award **VNDRLY/U Welding Quality — Inspector Preparation, Original Learning Program Completion** only after all gates. No AWS/API credential, engineering license, welder/NDT qualification or automatic production-acceptance authority is conferred. Review program annually as a VNDRLY maintenance practice and after relevant standard/process/assessment changes; determine targeted refresher needs for changed outcomes. This is not an asserted external renewal rule.


---

courses.title: VUC043 | VUC043 formative checks

content.title: VUC043 | VUC043 formative checks
content.description: Course completion records study only. Certification also requires the separately controlled examination and applicable observed assessments specified in the program. This VNDRLY/U curriculum counterpart does not award, replace, or claim accreditation by the external credential issuer.

lessons.title: VUC043 formative checks
lessons.body:
# VUC043 formative checks

Attempt before reading the response. Explain every correction, revisit its chapter/station and apply the changed case. These checks support instruction and do not replace the controlled final.

## Q01-L1

Does attractive weld appearance establish acceptance?

**Answer:** No; compare actual work and evidence with the governing requirements.

**Reason/remediation:** Appearance is only one part of the basis. Revisit Q01 and explain its changed case.

## Q01-L2

What does a drawing revision conflict require?

**Answer:** Resolve the affected technical basis before dependent acceptance.

**Reason/remediation:** Do not choose whichever revision is easier. Revisit Q01 and explain its changed case.

## Q02-L1

What is the ideal equal-leg throat for a10 mm right-angle fillet?

**Answer:** 10/√2=7.071 mm.

**Reason/remediation:** This is geometry, not measured effective throat. Revisit Q02 and explain its changed case.

## Q02-L2

Can a large convex cap prove fusion?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Surface size and internal fusion are different evidence. Revisit Q02 and explain its changed case.

## Q03-L1

Does a certificate in the folder establish every plate?

**Answer:** No; it must trace to the actual piece.

**Reason/remediation:** Dimensions alone do not link heat identity. Revisit Q03 and explain its changed case.

## Q03-L2

Does PMI establish heat treatment?

**Answer:** Not by itself.

**Reason/remediation:** Chemistry and treatment/property evidence differ. Revisit Q03 and explain its changed case.

## Q04-L1

Does common shielding gas make GTAW and GMAW interchangeable?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Process and qualification variables differ. Revisit Q04 and explain its changed case.

## Q04-L2

Why record which process deposited the root?

**Answer:** Procedure/personnel support and examination depend on actual production.

**Reason/remediation:** A process list alone can hide unsupported deposition. Revisit Q04 and explain its changed case.

## Q05-L1

Which record directs production?

**Answer:** The approved applicable WPS.

**Reason/remediation:** PQR records qualification facts; performance record addresses personnel. Revisit Q05 and explain its changed case.

## Q05-L2

Can a qualified welder cure an unsupported WPS?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Procedure and personnel requirements are independent. Revisit Q05 and explain its changed case.

## Q06-L1

Does low-hydrogen designation prove storage history?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Actual handling/exposure must meet approved instructions. Revisit Q06 and explain its changed case.

## Q06-L2

May an inspector invent a re-bake cycle?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Use manufacturer and approved procedure requirements. Revisit Q06 and explain its changed case.

## Q07-L1

Why inspect fit-up before closure?

**Answer:** Later passes can obscure geometry and root condition.

**Reason/remediation:** A missed hold cannot be reconstructed by a signature. Revisit Q07 and explain its changed case.

## Q07-L2

Does corrected alignment clear a cracked tack?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** The tack is a separate quality condition. Revisit Q07 and explain its changed case.

## Q08-L1

Is hotter always safer?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Minimum and maximum thermal controls can both matter. Revisit Q08 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q08-L2
lessons.body:
## Q08-L2

Does a remote temperature prove specified joint temperature?

**Answer:** Not necessarily.

**Reason/remediation:** Location and timing are part of the measurement requirement. Revisit Q08 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q09-L1
lessons.body:
## Q09-L1

At20 V,150 A,180 mm/min, arc energy?

**Answer:** 1.0 kJ/mm.

**Reason/remediation:** Use60 seconds/minute and1000 J/kJ. Revisit Q09 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q09-L2
lessons.body:
## Q09-L2

Can net energy be compared directly to an arc-energy limit?

**Answer:** Only with a consistent defined convention; not automatically.

**Reason/remediation:** Efficiency changes the quantity. Revisit Q09 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q10-L1
lessons.body:
## Q10-L1

Is a WPS target an actual observation?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Logs must distinguish prescribed from measured values. Revisit Q10 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q10-L2
lessons.body:
## Q10-L2

Does correcting settings validate earlier deposition?

**Answer:** Not automatically.

**Reason/remediation:** Affected prior work needs disposition. Revisit Q10 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q11-L1
lessons.body:
## Q11-L1

Does tensile strength prove toughness?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Properties are distinct requirements. Revisit Q11 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q11-L2
lessons.body:
## Q11-L2

Is the HAZ necessarily melted?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** It experiences thermal change outside the fused region. Revisit Q11 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q12-L1
lessons.body:
## Q12-L1

Can delayed cracking make timing relevant?

**Answer:** Yes.

**Reason/remediation:** Immediate examination may not satisfy a required delayed check. Revisit Q12 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q12-L2
lessons.body:
## Q12-L2

Does merely waiting later validate an early examination?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** The examination itself must meet the specified timing. Revisit Q12 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q13-L1
lessons.body:
## Q13-L1

Is lamellar tearing simply porosity?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** It concerns parent-plate through-thickness deformation/separation. Revisit Q13 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q13-L2
lessons.body:
## Q13-L2

Why record when a crack appears?

**Answer:** Timing helps distinguish solidification, delayed and treatment-related candidates.

**Reason/remediation:** Appearance alone can be ambiguous. Revisit Q13 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q14-L1
lessons.body:
## Q14-L1

Is partial penetration always a defect?

**Answer:** No; compare with design intent and applicable criteria.

**Reason/remediation:** Some joints are intentionally partial penetration. Revisit Q14 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q14-L2
lessons.body:
## Q14-L2

Can a smooth cap prove root fusion?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Internal condition needs suitable evidence. Revisit Q14 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q15-L1
lessons.body:
## Q15-L1

Does adequate bead size clear misalignment?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Separate dimensional requirements remain. Revisit Q15 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q15-L2
lessons.body:
## Q15-L2

May heat straightening be improvised?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Geometry and material effects need approved control. Revisit Q15 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q16-L1
lessons.body:
## Q16-L1

Does correct duplex filler prove phase balance?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Thermal history and fabrication affect structure. Revisit Q16 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q16-L2
lessons.body:
## Q16-L2

Can all stainless families share one heat-treatment rule?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Material structures and responses differ. Revisit Q16 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q17-L1
lessons.body:
## Q17-L1

Does steel cleaning history establish titanium compatibility?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Material-specific contamination and chemistry concerns differ. Revisit Q17 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q17-L2
lessons.body:
## Q17-L2

Does a brazed joint passing a leak test prove all design requirements?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Strength, temperature and joining basis remain separate. Revisit Q17 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q18-L1
lessons.body:
## Q18-L1

Can one thermocouple establish every required region?

**Answer:** Not automatically.

**Reason/remediation:** Location and coverage must meet the procedure. Revisit Q18 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q18-L2
lessons.body:
## Q18-L2

Does a treatment certificate replace its required chart?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Actual time/temperature evidence remains needed. Revisit Q18 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q19-L1
lessons.body:
## Q19-L1

Does an oblique photo without a coplanar scale support precise size?

**Answer:** Not reliably.

**Reason/remediation:** Perspective and scale placement affect measurement. Revisit Q19 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q19-L2
lessons.body:
## Q19-L2

Does one gauge reading establish full-length size?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Coverage must match the required claim. Revisit Q19 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q20-L1
lessons.body:
## Q20-L1

Is MT suitable for every stainless alloy?

**Answer:** No; suitability depends on magnetic behavior and procedure.

**Reason/remediation:** Material name alone is insufficient. Revisit Q20 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q20-L2
lessons.body:
## Q20-L2

Does PT address all internal flaws?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** It addresses suitable surface-breaking indications. Revisit Q20 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q21-L1
lessons.body:
## Q21-L1

Load48,000 N divided by80 mm² equals what?

**Answer:** 600 MPa.

**Reason/remediation:** N/mm² equals MPa. Revisit Q21 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q21-L2
lessons.body:
## Q21-L2

May an unfavorable specimen be dropped to improve an average?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Use the applicable retest/identity rules and preserve all results. Revisit Q21 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q22-L1
lessons.body:
## Q22-L1

Can a missed excavation witness be backdated?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Record the nonconformance and obtain disposition. Revisit Q22 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q22-L2
lessons.body:
## Q22-L2

Does final leak tightness replace every weld requirement?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Examination and property requirements remain distinct. Revisit Q22 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q23-L1
lessons.body:
## Q23-L1

Does drained mean safe for hot work?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Residues, atmosphere and connected paths remain relevant. Revisit Q23 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q23-L2
lessons.body:
## Q23-L2

May oxygen be used as ventilation?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** It creates serious ignition hazards. Revisit Q23 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q24-L1
lessons.body:
## Q24-L1

Does one engineering disposition close unrelated missing records?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Its actual scope controls. Revisit Q24 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q24-L2
lessons.body:
## Q24-L2

What must a nonconformance record preserve?

**Answer:** Requirement, actual condition, affected scope, disposition and verification.

**Reason/remediation:** Do not overwrite failure with a later pass. Revisit Q24 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q25-L1
lessons.body:
## Q25-L1

Does this award AWS CWI?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** External eligibility/vision/exams remain separate. Revisit Q25 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q25-L2
lessons.body:
## Q25-L2

Does valid credential cure poor visibility?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Actual examination conditions matter. Revisit Q25 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q26-L1
lessons.body:
## Q26-L1

In supplied AWS-style below-line convention which side?

**Answer:** Arrow side.

**Reason/remediation:** Confirm actual drawing system first. Revisit Q26 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q26-L2
lessons.body:
## Q26-L2

Is pitch the clear gap?

**Answer:** Not under supplied center-to-center convention.

**Reason/remediation:** Subtract segment length. Revisit Q26 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q27-L1
lessons.body:
## Q27-L1

Can a fillet gauge prove internal fusion?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** It measures defined geometry. Revisit Q27 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q27-L2
lessons.body:
## Q27-L2

Why repeat a gauge reading?

**Answer:** To reveal inconsistent contact/technique.

**Reason/remediation:** Do not choose only favorable reading. Revisit Q27 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q28-L1
lessons.body:
## Q28-L1

Does more displayed precision prove accuracy?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Method and uncertainty matter. Revisit Q28 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q28-L2
lessons.body:
## Q28-L2

May rounding erase failure?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Apply actual decision rule. Revisit Q28 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q29-L1
lessons.body:
## Q29-L1

Can an exception be used with unknown conditions?

**Answer:** Not established.

**Reason/remediation:** Prove every required condition. Revisit Q29 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q29-L2
lessons.body:
## Q29-L2

Can a keyword number replace scope reading?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Read applicability, notes and precedence. Revisit Q29 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q30-L1
lessons.body:
## Q30-L1

Is every indication automatically a rejectable defect?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Apply valid classification/acceptance basis. Revisit Q30 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q30-L2
lessons.body:
## Q30-L2

May uncertain linear concern be dismissed cosmetically?

**Answer:** Not without appropriate disposition.

**Reason/remediation:** Follow actual referral/hold requirement. Revisit Q30 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q31-L1
lessons.body:
## Q31-L1

Does unseen station count as examined?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Record actual coverage. Revisit Q31 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q31-L2
lessons.body:
## Q31-L2

Can photo perspective replace a required gauge result?

**Answer:** Not automatically.

**Reason/remediation:** Use specified measurement evidence. Revisit Q31 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q32-L1
lessons.body:
## Q32-L1

Does geometry pass cure missing NDT?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Independent evidence. Revisit Q32 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q32-L2
lessons.body:
## Q32-L2

Does signed repair plan prove execution?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Verify actual completed conditions. Revisit Q32 and explain its changed case.

lessons.body:
# VUC043 source and objective register

Reviewed2026-11-18. Original VNDRLY available-source instruction; full current code equivalence is not claimed. No unavailable PDF acquisition is required to finish the supplied exercises. Use actual controlled standards for live design, qualification, examination and acceptance.

|S07|[TWI hydrogen cracking prevention](https://www.twi-global.com/technical-knowledge/job-knowledge/defects-hydrogen-cracks-in-steels-prevention-and-best-practice-046)|Hydrogen/structure/stress interaction; no generic preheat recipe.|

|S11|[TWI stainless weldability](https://www.twi-global.com/technical-knowledge/job-knowledge/weldability-of-materials-stainless-steel-020)|Material-family differences; no universal heat-input range.|
|S12|[TWI titanium weldability](https://www.twi-global.com/technical-knowledge/job-knowledge/weldability-of-materials-titanium-and-titanium-alloys-024)|Material-specific shielding/contamination concerns.|
|S13|[HSE NDT guidance](https://www.hse.gov.uk/comah/sragtech/techmeasndt.htm)|Method capability and limits; no personnel qualification conferred.|
|S14|[OSHA general-industry welding requirements](https://www.osha.gov/laws-regs/regulations/standardnumber/1910/1910.252/)|Hot-work/ventilation context; applicable jurisdiction and task controls must be established.|
|S15|[OSHA oil/gas hot-work guidance](https://www.osha.gov/etools/oil-and-gas/general-safety/hot-work-welding)|Operational hazard recognition, including concurrent entry considerations.|
|S16|[OSHA welding standards index](https://www.osha.gov/welding-cutting-brazing/standards)|Different industry scopes; this course does not collapse construction/maritime/general-industry rules.|

The full controlled API577/ASME/AWS texts and all current qualification variables, ranges and acceptance clauses were not comprehensively verified. The original project records deliberately supply the criteria needed for learning calculations and decisions. They must not be reused as normative rules. No external examination questions are copied. Source pages support selected concepts; the course's original examples and scoring do not claim independent welding-engineering certification.

Additional clinic references:

- S17: [TWI carbon/low-alloy steel weldability](https://www.twi-global.com/technical-knowledge/job-knowledge/weldability-of-materials-carbon-manganese-and-low-alloy-steels-019), for thermal-history/material-processing distinctions. Generic limits are not imported into exercises.

ClinicsC01–C03 map toQ09/Q11/Q16, C04 toQ04/Q10, C05–C06 toQ11/Q21, C07 toQ16 andC08 toQ05/Q24. Each has a worked/changed case and formative rubric. Numerical clinic results are included in verification-results.json.
