content.title: VUC046 | VUC046 delivery, advanced stations and credential rules
content.description: Course completion records study only. Certification also requires the separately controlled examination and applicable observed assessments specified in the program. This VNDRLY/U curriculum counterpart does not award, replace, or claim accreditation by the external credential issuer.

lessons.title: VUC046 delivery, advanced stations and credential rules
lessons.body: # VUC046 delivery, advanced stations and credential rules

lessons.title: Sequence, faculty and prerequisites
lessons.body:
## Sequence, faculty and prerequisites

This package includes the original Level II method foundation as instruction, not as an external qualification. Total40 teaching chapters,6 foundation clinics,16 application labs,40 stations,80 formative checks and two integrated dossiers. Teach/review foundation Q01–24 before advanced Q25–40. The advanced blocks develop technical leadership through actual procedure writing, validation analysis, examination design and audit decisions. Do not waive a foundation gap merely because a learner holds a management title.

Instructors must be demonstrably competent in each method/technical area taught and the applicable actual procedures; use appropriate method specialists for specialist critique. An ASNT credential or employer appointment is not created by this curriculum. Entry requires successful foundation challenge or completion and evidence of relevant practical experience appropriate to the advanced tasks. If these are missing, deliver the foundation and supervised practice first. Record the actual prerequisite decision.

Planning allocation96hours:64foundation learning/assessment activities,12advanced instruction,8advanced labs,6portfolio demonstrations,2integrated defense and4controlled comprehensive final. The foundation's earlier written-final allocation is used here as formative review; the40-case final below is the controlling VUC046 final. This planning total is not an external training-hours claim or guarantee of proficiency. Extend remediation and method practice as needed. Access/language accommodations preserve independent technical reasoning.

lessons.title: Equipment and observation requirements
lessons.body:
## Equipment and observation requirements

Retain the benign VT/PT/MT/UT equipment/reference specimens and pre-existing RT images described in the foundation. No radiation exposure or live industrial pressure/loading is introduced. Advanced tasks use the fully supplied synthetic records, calculators, controlled procedure forms and a benign mock VT block for W14 demonstration. Qualified assessors establish actual mock dimensions/feature truth privately. Specialist-method cases assess analysis and referral boundaries; they do not certify hands-on AE,ET,IR,LT,MFL or neutron operation.

Score each P station on its four stated elements0–2. Require6/8 plus correction of every gap and no critical error. Foundation P01–24 follow the same rules. Mandatory observed foundation method tasks remain P05–19 with RT limited to image interpretation. Advanced P27/P28/P38/P39/P40 require actual learner-authored products and independent oral defense; P28 also requires the learner to demonstrate their W14 instruction on the benign mock part. A plan claiming it could work is not a demonstrated instruction.

Critical errors: fabricated competence/results, unauthorized hazardous operation, concealed misses/invalid checks, accepting unexamined regions, changing acceptance without authority, or claiming external certification. Guided practice is distinct from independent final performance. Preserve original attempts and coaching.

lessons.title: P25 — Authority map
lessons.body:
## P25 — Authority map

Candidate completes the authority matrix for I46-B and explains method, employer, engineering, contractual and radiation responsibilities. Score actual scope, governing basis, referral and truthful decision. A job title alone earns no authority credit.

lessons.title: P26 — Personnel record decision
lessons.body:
## P26 — Personnel record decision

Candidate evaluates W09 against fictional E46 and writes separate decisions for R/S. Score verified evidence, arithmetic, missing requirements and honest chronology. No use of fictional hours as real ASNT eligibility.

lessons.title: P27 — Design an assessment
lessons.body:
## P27 — Design an assessment

Candidate produces W16's blueprint and three original application prompts with private reasoned keys, plus one blind benign practical task. Assessor checks outcome coverage, independence, scoring and remediation. Candidate must defend why each task tests its outcome; repeated definitions alone fail.

lessons.title: P28 — Demonstrate a procedure
lessons.body:
## P28 — Demonstrate a procedure

Candidate writes W14, then another suitably prepared participant follows it on the benign mock part while candidate/assessor observe. Record ambiguities and actual coverage/measurements. Candidate revises under control and independently explains validation limits. Score executable content, observed reproducibility, correction evidence and bounded claim. Do not pretend this mock validates industrial welding/NDT procedures.

lessons.title: P29 — Evaluate validation statistics
lessons.body:
## P29 — Evaluate validation statistics

Candidate computes W10 and explains denominators, confidence and representativeness. Score sensitivity/false calls, correct bound, model assumptions and qualified disposition. A100% universal detection claim from a finite easy sample is a critical error.

lessons.title: P30 — ET method review
lessons.body:
## P30 — ET method review

Candidate resolves W11's frequency and lift-off/material changes and drafts a qualified referral/validation requirement. Score physical scaling, confounders, limits and appropriate authority. No actual ET qualification inferred from paper arithmetic.

lessons.title: P31 — AE evidence review
lessons.body:
## P31 — AE evidence review

Candidate locates the supplied linear sources and responds to a noise-trigger and unauthorized-load card. Score timing model, source validity, noise distinction and loading boundary. No live loading exercise.

lessons.title: P32 — Thermal comparison review
lessons.body:
## P32 — Thermal comparison review

Candidate analyzes W12 and specifies missing metadata/comparable conditions without proposing unauthorized energized access. Score emissivity/reflection, load/environment, evidence preservation and safe access boundary.

lessons.title: P33 — Leak-data analysis
lessons.body:
## P33 — Leak-data analysis

Candidate calculates W12 throughput and absolute-temperature pressure effect, then identifies outgassing/stabilization uncertainties. Score units, arithmetic, model limits and no unsupported leak acceptance. No pressurization/vacuum operation performed.

lessons.title: P34 — MFL coverage and confirmation
lessons.body:
## P34 — MFL coverage and confirmation

Candidate marks W13 scanned/unscanned areas and evaluates sparse UT follow-up. Score coverage denominator, morphology/sizing limits, location reconciliation and bounded conclusion. A scanner's advertised coverage is not actual site coverage.

lessons.title: P35 — Neutron specialist referral
lessons.body:
## P35 — Neutron specialist referral

Candidate writes a feasibility question and critiques misregistered combined images. Score justified complementary contrast, registration/identity, radiation authority and honest scope. Do not operate sources or issue neutron credentials.

lessons.title: P36 — Advanced UT configuration review
lessons.body:
## P36 — Advanced UT configuration review

Candidate calculates W13 encoder error, identifies when linear correction is unsupported and drafts affected-data disposition. Score configuration/geometry, calculation, validation needs and retained raw evidence. Conventional-UT experience is not automatically advanced-technique competence.

lessons.title: P37 — Whole-system control
lessons.body:
## P37 — Whole-system control

Candidate responds to incompatible-consumable, degraded-reference and changed-processing cards. Score independent control gaps, affected interval, correction/revalidation and preserved data. Passing one instrument check cannot erase another system failure.

lessons.title: P38 — Controlled change decision
lessons.body:
## P38 — Controlled change decision

Candidate submits a change record for a new probe/software and missing customer approval. Score before/after technical impact, required validation, distinct authorities and truthful release state. Assessor challenges a request to backdate the revision; candidate must reject it.

lessons.title: P39 — Audit and effectiveness
lessons.body:
## P39 — Audit and effectiveness

Candidate completes W15 and designs an actual changed-task observation using W14's mock process. Score affected population, cause/containment, concrete correction and observed effectiveness. Complete fields without actual measurements fail.

lessons.title: P40 — Portfolio defense
lessons.body:
## P40 — Portfolio defense

Candidate presents authority matrix, personnel decisions, assessment blueprint, demonstrated procedure, validation analysis, method referrals, change record and audit closure for I46-B. Assessor introduces the changed approval condition without coaching. Score integration, evidence traceability, limits and independent reasoning. Missing substantive products cannot be replaced by a polished summary.

lessons.title: Comprehensive final and learning award
lessons.body:
## Comprehensive final and learning award

Private final has40cases×3decisions×2points=240. Pass192/240 and at least4/6 in every domain, with no critical error. Time240minutes; calculator/coursebook allowed; keys, collaboration and outside assistance prohibited. Foundation questions are retained as knowledge checks in this comprehensive form; prior exposure to that exact form requires using the changed cases for independent assessment. Protect both forms. Teach missed outcomes, use changed practice and reassess independently; after two unsuccessful changed attempts, individualized instruction and a new equivalent task are required.

Award requires80 formative responses/corrections, each of16labs≥8/10, I46-A≥16/20, I46-B≥20/24, each station≥6/8 with gaps corrected, mandatory actual method tasks and advanced portfolio defense, and the comprehensive final. Issue **VNDRLY/U NDT Technical Leadership Preparation—learning assessment completed**, listing actual observed methods, specialist analysis-only portions and RT image-only restriction. Do not issue “ASNT Level III” or employer certification. Actual external prerequisites, examinations and appointments remain separate.

Retain learner/version/hash, faculty competence, actual procedures, specimen truth references, observations, original failures, remediation, changed results, portfolio files and independent assessor/date. Authoring this material does not mean any learner completed it. Private-file separation is not access enforcement; maintain appropriate instructor distribution controls.


---

courses.title: VUC046 | VUC046 formative checks

content.title: VUC046 | VUC046 formative checks
content.description: Course completion records study only. Certification also requires the separately controlled examination and applicable observed assessments specified in the program. This VNDRLY/U curriculum counterpart does not award, replace, or claim accreditation by the external credential issuer.

lessons.title: VUC046 formative checks
lessons.body:
# VUC046 formative checks

Attempt before reading the response. Explain every correction, revisit its chapter/station and apply the changed case. These checks support instruction and do not replace the controlled final.

## Q01-L1

Does PT training establish UT authorization?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Method competence and employer authorization are specific. Revisit Q01 and explain its changed case.

## Q01-L2

Does no reported indication mean no flaw exists?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Results are bounded by actual capability and coverage. Revisit Q01 and explain its changed case.

## Q02-L1

Why review manufacturing history?

**Answer:** It informs likely feature types and orientation.

**Reason/remediation:** Method selection follows the actual examination question. Revisit Q02 and explain its changed case.

## Q02-L2

Is a geometric echo automatically a crack?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Correlate position, geometry and other evidence. Revisit Q02 and explain its changed case.

## Q03-L1

Are procedure and acceptance criteria identical?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Execution and disposition requirements serve different purposes. Revisit Q03 and explain its changed case.

## Q03-L2

May a missing acceptance rule be invented after testing?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Resolve the applicable approved basis. Revisit Q03 and explain its changed case.

## Q04-L1

Does nondestructive mean hazard-free?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Chemical, electrical, access and radiation hazards may remain. Revisit Q04 and explain its changed case.

## Q04-L2

What follows failed task protection?

**Answer:** Stop affected work and obtain valid correction/restart.

**Reason/remediation:** Schedule pressure cannot replace controls. Revisit Q04 and explain its changed case.

## Q05-L1

Can glare defeat a bright VT image?

**Answer:** Yes.

**Reason/remediation:** Brightness alone does not establish visible detail. Revisit Q05 and explain its changed case.

## Q05-L2

Can a scale in another plane prove exact feature size?

**Answer:** Not without valid geometric correction.

**Reason/remediation:** Perspective changes apparent relative dimensions. Revisit Q05 and explain its changed case.

## Q06-L1

Can rounding create conformity?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Preserve actual value and decision rule. Revisit Q06 and explain its changed case.

## Q06-L2

Is every indication a rejectable defect?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Relevance and acceptance criteria must be established. Revisit Q06 and explain its changed case.

## Q07-L1

Can PT exclude wholly buried discontinuities?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** It requires accessible suitable surface openings. Revisit Q07 and explain its changed case.

## Q07-L2

Are penetrant systems interchangeable?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Use the approved compatible process. Revisit Q07 and explain its changed case.

## Q08-L1

Can excess removal reduce PT indications?

**Answer:** Yes.

**Reason/remediation:** A cleaner background is not automatically a valid sensitive test. Revisit Q08 and explain its changed case.

## Q08-L2

Where do process times come from?

**Answer:** Applicable approved procedure/products.

**Reason/remediation:** Do not apply universal invented times. Revisit Q08 and explain its changed case.

## Q09-L1

Is PT indication size always actual flaw depth?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Surface indication does not establish depth. Revisit Q09 and explain its changed case.

## Q09-L2

Can reportable and rejectable differ?

**Answer:** Yes.

**Reason/remediation:** Apply each actual threshold separately. Revisit Q09 and explain its changed case.

## Q10-L1

Does MT suit every metal?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Material must suit the magnetic method. Revisit Q10 and explain its changed case.

## Q10-L2

Can one field direction guarantee all orientations?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Direction affects sensitivity and coverage. Revisit Q10 and explain its changed case.

## Q11-L1

Does a calibration sticker establish task setup?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Actual standardization/performance checks remain. Revisit Q11 and explain its changed case.

## Q11-L2

Is a direction indicator automatically a field-strength meter?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Use each device for its specified property. Revisit Q11 and explain its changed case.

## Q12-L1

Does switching power off prove demagnetization?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Required residual-field verification is separate. Revisit Q12 and explain its changed case.

## Q12-L2

Can residual-field acceptance replace indication acceptance?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** They are distinct requirements. Revisit Q12 and explain its changed case.

## Q13-L1

Why divide pulse-echo travel by two?

**Answer:** The corrected time covers outward and return paths.

**Reason/remediation:** Use the actual path model. Revisit Q13 and explain its changed case.

## Q13-L2

Does absent useful echo prove sound material?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Coupling/attenuation/geometry may prevent valid examination. Revisit Q13 and explain its changed case.

## Q14-L1

Does a new valid setup validate older failed-setup data?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Review the affected interval and required re-examination. Revisit Q14 and explain its changed case.

## Q14-L2

Can few spot readings prove complete wall coverage?

**Answer:** Not automatically.

**Reason/remediation:** Match scan plan and geometry to the required question. Revisit Q14 and explain its changed case.

## Q15-L1

Is angle measured from normal in the course geometry?

**Answer:** Yes.

**Reason/remediation:** Use the stated convention; another convention changes trigonometry. Revisit Q15 and explain its changed case.

## Q15-L2

Does probe travel alone establish examined volume?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Beam geometry, directions and access must support coverage. Revisit Q15 and explain its changed case.

## Q16-L1

Does doubling amplitude double flaw size?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Orientation/path/coupling and settings affect amplitude. Revisit Q16 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q16-L2
lessons.body:
## Q16-L2

Which formula applies to amplitude ratio in dB?

**Answer:** 20log10(A2/A1).

**Reason/remediation:** Do not confuse amplitude and power ratios. Revisit Q16 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q17-L1
lessons.body:
## Q17-L1

Does RT projection reveal every oriented flaw equally?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Orientation and superposition affect detection. Revisit Q17 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q17-L2
lessons.body:
## Q17-L2

Does an IQI establish every possible flaw is absent?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** It supports specified image quality, not universal detection. Revisit Q17 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q18-L1
lessons.body:
## Q18-L1

Which distance is denominator in the supplied unsharpness model?

**Answer:** Source-to-object distance.

**Reason/remediation:** Do not substitute source-to-detector distance. Revisit Q18 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q18-L2
lessons.body:
## Q18-L2

May image processing discard original evidence?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Preserve raw/original data and processing history. Revisit Q18 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q19-L1
lessons.body:
## Q19-L1

May an image trainee recover a stuck source?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Recovery requires separately authorized specialist response. Revisit Q19 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q19-L2
lessons.body:
## Q19-L2

Does an apparently off device prove source safety?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Use the actual radiation safety program and authorized clearance. Revisit Q19 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q20-L1
lessons.body:
## Q20-L1

Does knowing a method name confer competence?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Use qualified personnel and approved techniques. Revisit Q20 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q20-L2
lessons.body:
## Q20-L2

What should a complementary method address?

**Answer:** A named unresolved examination question.

**Reason/remediation:** More reports do not automatically resolve a limitation. Revisit Q20 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q21-L1
lessons.body:
## Q21-L1

Are attempted cells the same as validly examined cells?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Failed controls can invalidate attempts. Revisit Q21 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q21-L2
lessons.body:
## Q21-L2

Does sample acceptance establish unsampled regions?

**Answer:** Not automatically.

**Reason/remediation:** Coverage and sampling basis must support the conclusion. Revisit Q21 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q22-L1
lessons.body:
## Q22-L1

May a supervisor sign coverage never performed?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Authority cannot create missing evidence. Revisit Q22 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q22-L2
lessons.body:
## Q22-L2

Does coached practice equal independent assessment?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Record assistance and assess independently as required. Revisit Q22 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q23-L1
lessons.body:
## Q23-L1

Can a valid result be assigned to an uncertain serial?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Reliable component identity is essential. Revisit Q23 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q23-L2
lessons.body:
## Q23-L2

Does examiner report authorize fitness for service automatically?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Engineering/service authority is separate. Revisit Q23 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q24-L1
lessons.body:
## Q24-L1

Does payroll job title prove method experience?

**Answer:** Not alone.

**Reason/remediation:** Retain actual method-specific evidence. Revisit Q24 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q24-L2
lessons.body:
## Q24-L2

Does written RT success authorize exposures?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Radiation operation requires a separate authorized program. Revisit Q24 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q25-L1
lessons.body:
## Q25-L1

Does one method appointment confer all-method authority?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Match actual competence and appointment to the decision. Revisit Q25 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q25-L2
lessons.body:
## Q25-L2

Can a method expert alone authorize hazardous loading?

**Answer:** Not automatically.

**Reason/remediation:** Engineering and safety authority remain separate. Revisit Q25 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q26-L1
lessons.body:
## Q26-L1

Can employment time be counted automatically as method experience?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Verify actual work under the applicable program. Revisit Q26 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q26-L2
lessons.body:
## Q26-L2

Does a new written practice justify backdating credentials?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Maintain real chronology and impact review. Revisit Q26 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q27-L1
lessons.body:
## Q27-L1

Does memorized specimen truth prove blind detection?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Use independent appropriate tasks. Revisit Q27 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q27-L2
lessons.body:
## Q27-L2

Can access accommodations supply the technical answer?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Support access while preserving competence assessment. Revisit Q27 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q28-L1
lessons.body:
## Q28-L1

Does one easy notch validate all service flaws?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Represent claimed range and adverse conditions. Revisit Q28 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q28-L2
lessons.body:
## Q28-L2

When should validation criteria be set?

**Answer:** Before evaluating results.

**Reason/remediation:** Post hoc favorable limits undermine the demonstration. Revisit Q28 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q29-L1
lessons.body:
## Q29-L1

What is the sensitivity denominator?

**Answer:** Actual positive cases.

**Reason/remediation:** False-positive rate uses actual negatives instead. Revisit Q29 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q29-L2
lessons.body:
## Q29-L2

Does30/30 automatically mean100% reliable detection?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Sampling uncertainty and representativeness remain. Revisit Q29 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q30-L1
lessons.body:
## Q30-L1

Does quadrupling frequency increase skin depth?

**Answer:** No; it halves it when material properties are fixed.

**Reason/remediation:** Inverse-square-root scaling applies under the stated model. Revisit Q30 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q30-L2
lessons.body:
## Q30-L2

Is skin depth a guaranteed detection limit?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Signal capability depends on the full validated system. Revisit Q30 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q31-L1
lessons.body:
## Q31-L1

Does quiet AE prove no dormant flaw?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** AE depends on active sources under monitored conditions. Revisit Q31 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q31-L2
lessons.body:
## Q31-L2

May loading be increased simply to create signals?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Loading requires appropriate independent engineering/safety authorization. Revisit Q31 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q32-L1
lessons.body:
## Q32-L1

Does a color screenshot establish true temperature?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Measurement assumptions and metadata matter. Revisit Q32 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q32-L2
lessons.body:
## Q32-L2

Can unequal loads confound thermal comparison?

**Answer:** Yes.

**Reason/remediation:** Operating conditions affect apparent differences. Revisit Q32 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q33-L1
lessons.body:
## Q33-L1

Are Celsius values suitable for ideal-gas pressure ratios?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Use absolute temperature and pressure. Revisit Q33 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q33-L2
lessons.body:
## Q33-L2

Does pressure rise uniquely prove a leak?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Temperature, outgassing and other effects can contribute. Revisit Q33 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q34-L1
lessons.body:
## Q34-L1

Does MFL screening directly establish every remaining thickness?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Use validated sizing and required confirmation. Revisit Q34 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q34-L2
lessons.body:
## Q34-L2

Can scanned center establish unscanned edge condition?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Coverage limits remain explicit. Revisit Q34 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q35-L1
lessons.body:
## Q35-L1

Does X-ray qualification automatically include neutron work?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Specialist technique and radiation controls differ. Revisit Q35 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q35-L2
lessons.body:
## Q35-L2

Can misregistered images establish coincident features?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Alignment must be validated. Revisit Q35 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q36-L1
lessons.body:
## Q36-L1

Does a dense phased-array image prove complete coverage?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Validated beam/geometry/scan plan must support it. Revisit Q36 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q36-L2
lessons.body:
## Q36-L2

Can encoder error distort reported length?

**Answer:** Yes.

**Reason/remediation:** Position registration is part of measurement validity. Revisit Q36 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q37-L1
lessons.body:
## Q37-L1

Does instrument calibration alone validate an entire PT/RT system?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Consumables, processing/viewing and other controls also matter. Revisit Q37 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q37-L2
lessons.body:
## Q37-L2

Can an unknown substitute be accepted from similar appearance?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Verify compatibility and performance. Revisit Q37 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q38-L1
lessons.body:
## Q38-L1

May a new revision be backdated to justify old departures?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Preserve actual chronology and disposition. Revisit Q38 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q38-L2
lessons.body:
## Q38-L2

Are technical and contractual approvals identical?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Each required authority must be satisfied. Revisit Q38 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q39-L1
lessons.body:
## Q39-L1

Does training attendance prove corrective-action effectiveness?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Observe changed performance and actual evidence. Revisit Q39 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q39-L2
lessons.body:
## Q39-L2

Should past affected results be considered?

**Answer:** Yes where failure may affect them.

**Reason/remediation:** Future correction does not validate past work. Revisit Q39 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q40-L1
lessons.body:
## Q40-L1

Can a portfolio award grant external ASNT Level III?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** External credential and employer appointment remain separate. Revisit Q40 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Q40-L2
lessons.body:
## Q40-L2

What bounds recognition?

**Answer:** Actual assessed evidence and scope.

**Reason/remediation:** Strong wording cannot expand demonstrated competence. Revisit Q40 and explain its changed case.

lessons.title: Review boundaries
lessons.body:
## Review boundaries

Instruction includes the five methods on the public ASNT NDT Level II route and distinguishes related-method awareness. Upcoming outline transitions are not silently called current credential requirements. Actual training hours, experience, vision, employer examinations and maintenance are determined by the applicable route; the64hour VNDRLY plan is not an external eligibility claim. Radiation operations remain a separate qualification.

Physical method demonstrations and independent results are required for this course's practical-preparation award. This authoring work has not tested a real learner. Real training specimens/equipment must be verified by competent assessors; supplied paper cases cannot substitute for them. Private answer/specimen keys need controlled distribution beyond folder separation. Original materials completion, learner completion, external certification and publication remain separate states.

lessons.title: Scope statement
lessons.body:
## Scope statement

This original preparation program covers common-method foundation and advanced technical-leadership reasoning across the public method families. Specialist case analysis is not a full hands-on endorsement in each method. ASNT method examinations, employer appointments, adopted proprietary standard requirements and radiation/pressure safety qualifications are separate. Complete original materials under the available-source instruction do not establish “meets or exceeds” external equivalence, actual learner competence, publication or professional authorization.
