lessons.title: VUC048 advanced application workbook
lessons.body:
# VUC048 advanced application workbook

All case requirements are synthetic. Use current actual equipment instructions for physical tasks. S48 supplements only advanced cases; it does not change the supplied S47 foundation exercises.

lessons.title: S48 — Fictional advanced project brief
lessons.body:
## S48 — Fictional advanced project brief

Asset: mixed-substrate training facility F48: steel skid80m², concrete floor40m², two coated pipe field joints J1/J2, galvanized rails10m². Four different approved systems are assumed only where their case sheets supply actual requirements. R. Chen is owner release delegate; N. Patel is technical coating reviewer; trained contractor operators perform application. No pressure-integrity, fire-rating or CP adjustment authority is delegated to the learner.

Advanced case criteria: data logging hourly over120h, no missing required interval; hypothetical plural ratio4:1 with relative ratio error within±2%; concrete specified test result≤75%RH under its stated method, surface screen only informative; supplied pull-off acceptance≥6MPa with valid procedure/failure mode; hardness ShoreD≥70 under a valid method; disbondment test comparison only at identical stated conditions. These are invented teaching criteria, not AMPP/ASTM/ISO rules. Actual project values may differ.

lessons.title: W09 — Design an inspection plan and verify records
lessons.body:
## W09 — Design an inspection plan and verify records

**Packet:** six reports R1–R6. Missing post-checks R1,R2,R3,R4; wrong asset IDs R3,R4,R5; R6 complete. Proposed plan tests lining after closure, no access; contractor wants signature before cure. Build an ITP and unique affected-record list.

**Model:** union R1–R5 is5/6=83.333% affected, not7/6. Classify missing checks separately from ID problems, establish actual measurement provenance and affected intervals, obtain valid retests where needed. Do not correct IDs by guess. ITP places valid cured-lining testing before closure with explicit hold, access and responsible release. Required fields: stage, location, requirement/revision, method/sampling, equipment/checks, responsible person, notification/hold, record and exception action.

**Changed:** R3 ID is reconciled from raw records but its post-check still missing. R3 remains affected. R6 now has an omitted required zone; affected set becomes all6, despite one correction. Explain the distinction between corrected data and performed work.

lessons.title: W10 — Logger outage and controlled environment
lessons.body:
## W10 — Logger outage and controlled environment

Expected120 hourly records,108 present. Missing interval12h includes an enclosure opening and dehumidifier outage. Existing logs show surface20°C/dewpoint16°C before outage and surface19/dewpoint15 after. Product requires spread≥3 throughout. Calculate availability and known margins; decide whether cure compliance is established.

**Model:**90% records available; both known margins4°C. The gap prevents proving continuous specified conditions, and before/after values cannot fill it. Identify affected coating/time, preserve outage and access records, seek authorized evaluation. Do not claim that90% data means90% passing cure. Heating alone is not evidence that water was removed.

**Changed:** a second valid independent logger covers the12h but was positioned at the warm air outlet rather than the cold surface. Evaluate representativeness before using it. A third documented surface sensor shows spread2°C for2h: preserve actual failure, not an interpolated passing line.

lessons.title: W11 — Concrete and plural-component cases
lessons.body:
## W11 — Concrete and plural-component cases

Concrete slab age28days. Surface screening meter reads a favorable relative indication; specified in-situ result78%RH against75%limit. Surface profile matches the required comparator but one weak patch crumbles. Separately, plural collection givesA3.8L/B1.0L versus4:1±2% relative ratio error. Identify each independent condition.

**Model:** in-situ result exceeds limit by3percentage points; screening does not replace it. Matching texture does not prove strength; weak patch requires approved treatment/evaluation. Delivered ratio3.8;relative error(3.8−4)/4×100=−5%, outside by3percentage points beyond the2% bound. Identify affected application since last valid ratio check; the machine setpoint alone is not proof.

**Changed:** A4.04L/B1L gives4.04, error+1%, within supplied ratio range, but static mixer condition is unknown. Correct ratio does not prove mixing. New floor moisture74% passes that criterion, while weak patch remains unresolved.

lessons.title: W12 — Pipeline and specialized system continuity
lessons.body:
## W12 — Pipeline and specialized system continuity

J1 has passing thickness and holiday records but missing overlap/cure records. J2 fully documented before lowering-in, then scraped during handling. Rails have paint approved for galvanizing but preparation sheet is bare-steel abrasive cleaning. Fire-protection sample meets DFT but specified mesh record is absent. Write a four-item disposition table.

**Model:** J1 pending required joint evidence; J2 damaged region requires mapped approved repair/retest despite earlier acceptance; rails need appropriate galvanized preparation procedure; fire-protection assembly conformity not established without required mesh evidence. None of these findings authorizes pressure-integrity or fire-rating conclusions. Concrete weight coating, where present, must not conceal unfinished corrosion-barrier inspection.

**Changed:** J1 overlap and cure evidence arrives with correct identity/time; resolve J1 only after checking all requirements. J2 repaired but no continuity retest remains open. Rails' new procedure is approved but operator competence not established; approval is not personal qualification.

lessons.title: W13 — Thickness physics and pull-off stress
lessons.body:
## W13 — Thickness physics and pull-off stress

Simplified coating echo time.6µs, assumed velocity2mm/µs. Known appropriate material velocity1.8. Calculate both thicknesses and relative overstatement using true-model value as denominator. Pull force2000N on20mm diameter dolly; calculate nominal stress using areaπd²/4. Repeat for10mm. State why calculations alone cannot validate the tests.

**Model:** assumed.6mm,appropriate.54mm,difference.06mm;overstatement11.111%.20mm area314.159mm²,stress6.366MPa.10mm area78.540,stress25.465MPa, fourfold. Actual ultrasound needs correct interface/model/reference; pull-off needs valid preparation/loading/failure mode and authorization. Do not use guessed velocity or dolly size to produce a desired pass.

**Changed:** force1500N on20mm gives4.775MPa, below fictional6. A result wholly in glue does not establish coating/substrate failure at that value. A multilayer gauge displays only one interface; do not invent individual layer thicknesses.

lessons.title: W14 — Hardness and laboratory comparability
lessons.body:
## W14 — Hardness and laboratory comparability

Records: specimenA ShoreA75, specimenB ShoreD72, specimenC ShoreD68. S48 requires validD≥70. All B/C procedures valid; A is wrong scale. Lab disbondment: systemX radius5mm after7days at25°C;Y8mm after28days at40°C. Later matched-condition results areX6,Y7 at28days/25°C, with a fictional maximum6.5.

**Model:** A does not establish required scale;B meets criterion;C fails by2. Hardness does not replace service-cure evidence. Original X/Y results not directly comparable because time/temperature differ. Matched results:X passes6.5max,Y exceeds by.5, but only for the specified test and valid measurement basis. No unsupported field-life prediction.

**Changed:** B's sample is too thin for the method; reassess validity despite72. Matched Y sample identity is missing; cannot assign its result confidently to the production system. Preserve uncertainty instead of quietly substituting X's report.

lessons.title: W15 — Survey and repair strategy
lessons.body:
## W15 — Survey and repair strategy

Asset100m²;80m² inspected,12m² damaged;20m² inaccessible. Of inspected damage,8m² localized and4m² widespread within a known exposure zone. Existing system identity uncertain. Prepare area calculations, survey limits and next-stage plan; do not prescribe a universal repair system.

**Model:**15% of inspected area damaged;12% of total asset observed damaged;20% uninspected. These denominators answer different questions. Identify the distribution, access limits and system uncertainty; obtain compatibility/adhesion/substrate evidence and hazardous-material assessment as applicable before choosing spot repair/overcoat/removal. Do not mark the20m² sound.

**Changed:** remaining20m² inspected and8m² damaged. Total damage20/100=20%. Revise maintenance assessment using actual new distribution; do not retain15% simply because it was in the first report. A priority decision must include consequence and exposure, not percentage alone.

lessons.title: W16 — Audit, electronic import and closure
lessons.body:
## W16 — Audit, electronic import and closure

Four repairs R1–R4, raw retests for R1,R2,R3 only. Spreadsheet has four rows because R3 was imported twice as R4; timestamps and specimen IDs reveal duplicate. One column importsmils asµm. Raw value4mils is displayed4µm. Build corrected closure register and data-validation procedure.

**Model:** three unique repair retests,75% of four required;R4 pending.4mils=101.6µm;unit mislabel can change decisions. Preserve original export, identify all affected imports, correct mapping with documented known-value checks, regenerate reports and notify affected recipients. Do not treat duplicate rows as evidence of physical work.

**Changed:** actual R4 retest arrives and all four identities match. Close only after authorized comparison and other repair requirements. Retain the import defect and corrective action so later reports do not repeat it.

lessons.title: I49-B — Advanced portfolio
lessons.body:
## I49-B — Advanced portfolio

Use F48 and W09–16. Contractor proposes Friday handover, owner asks advanced inspector to sign all systems because “the instruments passed.” Required portfolio: executable multi-system ITP; raw-data review with affected sets; environmental gap disposition; concrete and plural-system findings; pipe-joint/rail/fire-system limitations; actual instrument/destructive-test station sheets; condition survey with denominators; repair closure register; factual handover and escalation letter.

**Model letter:** identify exactly which tests and zones are supported; list missing or invalid evidence by system, affected stage and responsible decision maker. Instrument checks are necessary but do not prove cure, compatibility, coverage or design. Propose the specific safe evidence/rework route from each workbook, with authorized technical review where needed. Do not issue pressure-integrity, CP adjustment or fire-rating claims.

**Changed:** all steel-skid items are resolved, concrete moisture now passes but surface-strength patch remains; J1 complete, J2 retest pending; rails correct procedure/competent operator confirmed; fire-system mesh remains undocumented. Updated handover releases only the actually supported scope under designated authority, leaving named unresolved items. Explain why partial technical resolution is neither blanket rejection nor blanket acceptance.

lessons.body:

Destructive test: permission___ sample/location___ apparatus/reference___ dolly/cut geometry___ preparation/cure___ loading/method___ raw force/readings___ failure mode/proportions___ calculation___ validity___ criterion___ repair___ assessor___

Survey: asset/area___ inspected/uninspected___ method___ defect type/extent___ denominator___ exposure___ system identity___ uncertainty___ recommendation basis___ further tests___

content.title: VUC049 | VUC049 senior decision laboratories
content.description: Course completion records study only. Certification also requires the separately controlled examination and applicable observed assessments specified in the program. lessons.title: VUC049 senior decision laboratories
lessons.body:
# VUC049 senior decision laboratories

Use foundation W01–16 and I49-A/B first. All new limits and assets are fictional. S49 supplies complete decision clauses; no proprietary text is implied.

lessons.title: W17 — Conflicting clauses and concession
lessons.body:
## W17 — Conflicting clauses and concession

**S49 clauses:** five spots in each zone; three readings per spot; every reading≥120µm and≤180µm; every mean≥140µm and≤165µm; no averaging across zones; all required locations must be inspected. Only owner delegate R. Chen may issue a documented concession after technical review by N. Patel. A concession does not retrospectively alter raw results. Contractor requests applying an unapproved draft revision that lowers mean minimum to135 but retains individual limits.

ZoneA spot readings: A1(135,145,155),A2(115,150,170),A3(138,139,140),A4(150,155,160),A5 missing. Produce means, nonconformances, clarification request and report language.

**Model:** means145,145,139,155;A1/A4 satisfy supplied limits;A2 fails115 individual minimum despite mean145;A3 fails mean by1;A5 not inspected. Draft revision cannot be used without approval and would not resolve A2/A5. Record all actual data and ask whether a formal change/concession is sought. Do not label a concession as original compliance.

**Changed:** approved revision lowers mean minimum to135 for this job, applies prospectively and authorizes reevaluation of recorded data. A3 can be reevaluated against new rule with revision trail;A2/A5 remain. Later concession accepts A2 specifically after technical review; record accepted by concession, not a changed115. A5 remains incomplete. Prepare a handover showing three distinct states.

lessons.title: W18 — Staffing and hold scheduling
lessons.body:
## W18 — Staffing and hold scheduling

Twelve independent zones each need25min measurements,10min records,5min access. Shared startup reference/briefing30min and final review30min. Available window6h. One competent inspector initially; second has DFT competence but no authorization for the separate destructive station. Contractor proposes omitting access/records time and reducing spots.

**Model:** zones480min plus60=540min=9h;single-inspector shortfall180min. Two equally capable inspectors can divide six zones each:240min plus shared60=300min=5h, if access/resources genuinely permit concurrent work. Do not silently reduce required measurements. The destructive task still needs its authorized competent personnel and time; the simplified capacity estimate excludes it and cannot claim the entire project complete.

**Changed:** only one gauge available, and measurements cannot overlap. Pure measurement demand300min plus shared60=360min consumes the full window before unavoidable access/record effects unless a valid sequence supports overlap. Do not claim a guaranteed5h completion. Produce a feasible revised schedule or request resource/window change, retaining requirements.

lessons.title: W19 — Environmental interruption and cause investigation
lessons.body:
## W19 — Environmental interruption and cause investigation

AssetT49 lining, requirement spread≥3°C through48h cure, hourly log. Forty records exist; eight-hour gap includes ventilation/dehumidification trip. Coating batch ratio documented correct; local film250µm against fictional maximum200; surface soft in that region. Old coating hazard assessment exists, but safe restart after ventilation trip has no record. Owner requests an immediate “bad paint” conclusion.

**Model:** logger availability40/48=83.333%;8h gap. Film exceeds maximum by50µm or25% of maximum. Correct ratio does not prove cure; soft film has multiple possible contributors. Safe access/restart requires actual control evidence before further inspection. Preserve sample identity and raw conditions, determine affected application/cure interval, obtain product-specific technical evaluation and authorized repair/testing. Do not blame material solely from softness or infer that an outage caused every defect.

**Changed:** independent representative logger resolves the gap with all margins≥4, but excessive thickness remains. Update environmental conclusion; investigate film/cure and product evidence rather than retaining a disproven environmental allegation. A laboratory sample from another tank cannot resolve T49 chemistry.

lessons.title: W20 — Process restart, records and dispute
lessons.body:
## W20 — Process restart, records and dispute

Plural application last valid delivered-ratio check09:00. Alarm at09:40; application continued until10:00. At10:15 equipment corrected and verification passes. Six zones coated:Z1 08:30–08:55,Z2 09:05–09:15,Z3 09:15–09:25,Z4 09:25–09:35,Z5 09:35–09:45,Z6 09:45–10:00. Alarm reliability not yet established. Contractor wants only Z6 reviewed. Develop affected scope and restart/reinspection plan.

**Model:** Z2–Z6 fall after last established good condition and require evaluation until evidence narrows the interval;Z1 is not automatically implicated by this fault.09:40alarm does not prove all earlier delivery valid. Corrected equipment supports restart only under actual verified procedure and safe conditions; it does not repair prior coating. Preserve timestamps, ratio/material/temperature/mixer records, identify safe sampling and authorized disposition, then repair/reinspect actual affected regions.

**Changed:** reliable continuous ratio records demonstrate correct delivery through09:30, with a confirmed change then. Z4's portion after09:30 andZ5–Z6 remain affected by ratio issue;Z2/Z3 can be cleared for that issue, not automatically all requirements. Record partial-zone boundary. A concession offered for Z5 must remain distinct from original conformity.

lessons.title: I49-C — Senior portfolio and rehearsal
lessons.body:
## I49-C — Senior portfolio and rehearsal

Prepare a senior oversight dossier combining W17–20 with the foundation mixed-substrate project. Deliver: responsibility/competence matrix; clause register; executable staged ITP; capacity estimate with assumptions; affected-work timeline/map; cause/evidence matrix; original and corrected report examples; proposed technical disposition with authority; concise oral briefing.

**Worked briefing structure:** “The current hold covers [specific zones/stages]. The controlling requirement is [supplied clause/revision]. We observed [raw evidence]. The calculation is [units/work]. This establishes [bounded conclusion], while [uncertainty] remains. The next authorized action is [specific evidence/correction], owned by [role]. Release requires [actual conditions].” Populate it with the case facts; reciting blanks is not completion.

**Changed rehearsal:** panel supplies an approved revision, a valid new measurement and an unrelated missing record. Revise the actual disposition item by item. The instructor should challenge unsupported statements and ask the learner to distinguish production evidence from training examples. Rehearsal is coached learning, not the controlled oral examination.

lessons.title: Senior record forms
lessons.body:
## Senior record forms

Authority matrix: task/substrate/method___ person___ competence evidence___ appointment/supervision___ hold role___ alternate___ exclusions___

Clause register: document/revision___ actual clause/quantity___ units/statistic___ sampling___ decision rule___ conflict___ authorized resolution/date___ affected records___

Investigation matrix: observation___ possible causes___ distinguishing evidence___ sample identity___ safe collection___ result___ revised inference___ unresolved___

Oral/decision record: case___ facts___ calculation___ criterion___ immediate action___ conclusion___ uncertainty___ next evidence/owner___ changed facts___ revised decision___ assessor rationale___

content.title: VUC049 | Foundation stations
content.description: Course completion records study only. Certification also requires the separately controlled examination and applicable observed assessments specified in the program. This VNDRLY/U curriculum counterpart does not award, replace, or claim accreditation by the external credential issuer.

lessons.title: Foundation stations
lessons.body: # Foundation stations

lessons.title: P01 — Explain assignment scope
lessons.body:
## P01 — Explain assignment scope

Use TS47 plus request for internal tank release. Learner writes the authorized inspected scope and identifies the mismatch. Score asset identification, scope distinction, authority referral and accurate credential wording.

lessons.title: P02 — Corrosion and surface findings
lessons.body:
## P02 — Corrosion and surface findings

Show safe pit/scale exemplars and supplied history “steel skid, intermittent wetting, depth not measured.” Learner distinguishes observation from mechanism and refers structural concerns. Score electrochemical explanation, localized/general distinction, evidence limits and appropriate referral.

lessons.title: P03 — Readiness walkdown
lessons.body:
## P03 — Readiness walkdown

Inspect the real bench and respond to cards “unknown old coating,” “unassessed tank entry,” “spray injection suspected.” Score hazard identification, relevant information/controls, stop/emergency decision and valid restart conditions. Do not create real exposures.

lessons.title: P04 — ITP and revisions
lessons.body:
## P04 — ITP and revisions

Use W01. Learner creates a one-page executable ITP with H1–H3, notification responsibilities and conflict register. Score correct revisions, required checks/sequence, hold authority and unresolved-condition record.

lessons.title: P05 — Instrument verification
lessons.body:
## P05 — Instrument verification

Learner identifies actual DFT probe/reference, verifies before and after a measurement set and records raw values. Introduce a paper post-check failure after the valid physical task. Score reference suitability, correct operation, traceable values and affected-data response. Instructor retains actual manufacturer tolerances; S47 tolerance applies only to its paper case.

lessons.title: P06 — Environmental measurement
lessons.body:
## P06 — Environmental measurement

Learner takes stabilized air/RH/dewpoint and surface measurements at two real safe locations, records time and calculates spread; then evaluates W02 changed record. Score sensor placement/stabilization, complete raw data, spread/limits reasoning and recheck/hold decision.

lessons.title: P07 — Precleaning inspection
lessons.body:
## P07 — Precleaning inspection

Present clean panel, safe oily-fingerprint simulation and burr photograph. Learner maps findings and specifies authorized next steps without live grinding or solvent use. Score contamination distinction, defect identification, preparation sequence and reinspection requirement.

lessons.title: P08 — Method and visual comparison
lessons.body:
## P08 — Method and visual comparison

Use prepared-panel exemplars and their documented preparation methods, plus W03 cleanliness/profile mismatch. Learner distinguishes method, visual condition and profile, and explains where an actual standard is required. Score selection, separate requirements, equipment-condition recognition and bounded acceptance.

lessons.title: P09 — Profile measurement
lessons.body:
## P09 — Profile measurement

Learner selects correct actual grade/method, performs independent measurements at assessor-selected locations and records units/mode. Score range selection, correct technique/backing treatment, representative traceable readings and comparison with supplied specimen requirement. An out-of-range reading requires valid method change, not extrapolation.

lessons.title: P10 — Contamination test
lessons.body:
## P10 — Contamination test

Learner performs a safe extraction/blank measurement on the prepared training surface using its kit instructions, records area/volume/units and checks for leakage. Then performs the specified dust observation on a separate sample. Score contamination control, extraction validity, distinct salt/dust records and appropriate invalid-test response. Known salt loading is a method exercise, not production contamination.

lessons.title: P11 — Product compatibility review
lessons.body:
## P11 — Product compatibility review

Supply E47 label, different-curing-agent label and proposed immersion service not in S47. Learner records identity and unresolved compatibility. Score product/component matching, mechanism/role explanation, service limitation and authorized disposition route.

lessons.title: P12 — Mix and clock demonstration
lessons.body:
## P12 — Mix and clock demonstration

Using water-based surrogate and vessels, learner measures a scaled4:1 volume batch, starts timer and records simulated induction/pot-life times. No real reactive coating is needed. Score ratio/basis, measured amounts, complete clock record and refusal to extend pot life with thinner. Add W04 mass-ratio change for interpretation.

lessons.title: P13 — Application observation
lessons.body:
## P13 — Application observation

Use an edge/weld mock-up and supplied stripe-before-broad-coat sequence. Learner marks vulnerable regions and records omitted stripe condition. Score geometry recognition, correct sequence, contamination awareness and factual nonconformance.

lessons.title: P14 — WFT demonstration
lessons.body:
## P14 — WFT demonstration

Apply benign surrogate to a training panel; learner uses an appropriate clean comb, reads the wet/dry tooth interval and calculates predicted DFT from supplied solids. Score technique, interval rather than false precision, arithmetic and distinction from final acceptance. Restore the training surface safely.

lessons.title: P15 — DFT demonstration
lessons.body:
## P15 — DFT demonstration

Learner selects substrate-compatible mode, verifies setup and measures blind assigned locations. Score substrate/range suitability, actual technique, raw/location records and valid instrument checks. Compare with assessor's reference range accounting for instrument uncertainty, not a memorized exact answer.

lessons.title: P16 — Sampling and disposition
lessons.body:
## P16 — Sampling and disposition

Learner completes an actual five-spot training map and separately evaluates W05. Score complete coverage, preserved readings, individual/mean rules and invalid/inaccessible classification. Do not pass someone who hides a low reading inside a mean.

lessons.title: P17 — Cure timeline
lessons.body:
## P17 — Cure timeline

Use W06 and a changed cold-period card. Learner draws timeline and identifies valid versus unsupported timing. Score induction clock, recoat window, service-cure timing and missing-condition referral.

lessons.title: P18 — Defect description
lessons.body:
## P18 — Defect description

Use safe labeled example photographs or assessor-prepared benign samples of runs, pinholes and soft-film records. Learner writes observable findings and a prioritized evidence request. Score location/extent, correct observation, alternative-cause reasoning and no unauthorized destructive action.

lessons.title: P19 — Low-voltage continuity
lessons.body:
## P19 — Low-voltage continuity

Under competent supervision, learner checks approved low-voltage equipment on known holiday/sound regions, then independently scans the assigned benign panel, maps findings and responds to a simulated lost-return card. Score valid verification, safe correct scan/coverage, mapped results and affected-area retest. No live high-voltage substitute.

lessons.title: P20 — Adhesion interpretation
lessons.body:
## P20 — Adhesion interpretation

Use W07 glue failure and changed valid result. Learner states what each proves, what remains unknown and repair/test authorization. Score failure-mode recognition, numerical comparison, bounded scope and safe test/repair planning.

lessons.title: P21 — Changed substrate
lessons.body:
## P21 — Changed substrate

Present steel, galvanized and concrete sample identities. Learner identifies why S47 cannot be transferred unchanged and lists the specific missing basis. Score substrate identification, method compatibility, preparation limits and competent referral.

lessons.title: P22 — Nonconformance record
lessons.body:
## P22 — Nonconformance record

Learner completes W05 A3/A4 records and a repaired retest entry using workbook forms. Score exact requirement, raw evidence/location, correction traceability and closure authority. Unsupported “fixed” is not closure.

lessons.title: P23 — Conflict role-play
lessons.body:
## P23 — Conflict role-play

Instructor asks learner to sign the missing B5 inspection to meet schedule. Learner explains the evidence gap and escalation path, then responds to later valid evidence. Score clear factual communication, refusal to fabricate, proportionate escalation and fair record correction.

lessons.title: P24 — Integrated handover
lessons.body:
## P24 — Integrated handover

Independently complete I49-A and its changed dossier. Score chronology/zone coverage, defensible dispositions, actual linked evidence and accurate service-authority boundary. Require the full dossier, not oral assurances that it could be prepared.

lessons.title: Advanced stations
lessons.body: # Advanced stations

lessons.title: P25 — Executable multi-system ITP
lessons.body:
## P25 — Executable multi-system ITP

Using F48, learner produces stage-specific ITP including access/cure before closure and different system requirements. Score scope/revisions, executable sequence/sampling, authority/holds and exceptions/records.

lessons.title: P26 — Verify junior work
lessons.body:
## P26 — Verify junior work

Use W09 raw packet; learner identifies unique affected records and differentiates errors from absent measurements. Score correct affected set, evidence classification, proportionate correction/retest and traceable feedback without unsupported misconduct accusation.

lessons.title: P27 — CP and laboratory scope
lessons.body:
## P27 — CP and laboratory scope

Use W14 disbondment records and diagram of galvanic versus powered systems. Learner explains interface and comparison limits without changing any equipment. Score system distinction, test-condition comparison, bounded inference and specialist referral.

lessons.title: P28 — Logger setup and review
lessons.body:
## P28 — Logger setup and review

Learner configures a real safe environmental logger, verifies identity/time/interval, records and exports a short actual bench sequence; then analyzes W10 outage. Score actual setup, representative sensor placement, complete raw export and gap/affected-work treatment. Short bench run demonstrates instrument use, not120h of production cure.

lessons.title: P29 — Preparation process review
lessons.body:
## P29 — Preparation process review

Use safe equipment diagrams/media specimens and waterjet/centrifugal process records. Learner identifies method output and separate contamination/profile/flash-rust conditions. Score method distinction, actual acceptance-basis identification, coverage/media controls and safe no-interlock-bypass response.

lessons.title: P30 — Concrete preparation and moisture
lessons.body:
## P30 — Concrete preparation and moisture

Learner compares a real prepared concrete sample with the specified reference, takes appropriate safe surface-screen readings and reviews a supplied valid in-situ record. Score actual profile use, method/units validity, screening-versus-acceptance distinction and weak-surface/referral decision. The station does not claim the surface screen independently demonstrates in-situ RH.

lessons.title: P31 — Plural ratio and affected work
lessons.body:
## P31 — Plural ratio and affected work

Learner measures safe surrogate volumes at a bench, computes W11 relative error and identifies affected interval from a fault card. Score basis/measurement, arithmetic, ratio-versus-mixing distinction and bounded rework/record route. No pressurized sprayer operation.

lessons.title: P32 — Field-joint inspection plan
lessons.body:
## P32 — Field-joint inspection plan

Use safe pipe-joint mock-up and W12 records. Learner maps overlap, cutbacks and handling damage, then writes required evidence/retest sequence. Score actual regions, product compatibility/sequence, separate criteria and repair traceability.

lessons.title: P33 — Specialized assembly review
lessons.body:
## P33 — Specialized assembly review

Use rubber-seam, metallic-layer and fire-system diagrams with W12 missing mesh. Learner produces system-specific limits and referrals. Score assembly identification, distinct inspection needs, missing evidence and no unsupported fire-rating claim.

lessons.title: P34 — Specialized thickness instruments
lessons.body:
## P34 — Specialized thickness instruments

Learner uses actual suitable ultrasonic gauge on a known coated nonmetallic specimen and compatible eddy-current gauge on a coated nonferrous panel. Verify references, record settings/raw values and explain interface limitations. Score method suitability, actual valid technique, traceable reference/results and no invented layer resolution. Both methods must be demonstrated.

lessons.title: P35 — Destructive specimen tests
lessons.body:
## P35 — Destructive specimen tests

On authorized sacrificial training panels, learner prepares and performs a pull-off test using actual apparatus/manual, records geometry/force/failure mode and calculates stress. Also measures an actual safely prepared coating cross-section with calibrated optics, with supervised cutting only where approved. Score permission/safe setup, actual method execution, valid calculation/interpretation and complete repair/disposal/records. Adhesive cure may require preparation before the session; learner verifies actual preparation evidence. Do not substitute a paper force for the physical task.

lessons.title: P36 — Hardness measurement
lessons.body:
## P36 — Hardness measurement

Learner verifies a real appropriate durometer, performs independent measurements on a suitable known specimen and records scale/dwell/conditions. Score reference/method suitability, actual technique, raw reproducible data and bounded cure inference. No hazardous solvent test is required.

lessons.title: P37 — Condition survey
lessons.body:
## P37 — Condition survey

Learner surveys a safe training assembly with assessor-known damaged/sound regions, creates a map and evaluates W15 area records. Score observation/extent, correct denominators, uninspected limits and evidence-based maintenance proposal.

lessons.title: P38 — Failure-investigation packet
lessons.body:
## P38 — Failure-investigation packet

Prepare a sample chain-of-custody form and evidence request from a simulated failed lining; use W14 mismatched laboratory conditions. Score identity/orientation preservation, noncontaminating sampling plan, comparison limits and alternative hypotheses. Actual unknown hazardous material sampling is excluded.

lessons.title: P39 — Electronic record and repair audit
lessons.body:
## P39 — Electronic record and repair audit

Use W16 raw rows and a simple learner-created table; learner detects duplicate identity/unit error and produces corrected register with retained originals. Score unique physical evidence, units/import validation, affected-report correction and closure based on actual retest.

lessons.title: P40 — Portfolio defense
lessons.body:
## P40 — Portfolio defense

Submit I49-B dossier and answer its changed facts independently. Score integration, precise remaining gaps, actual linked station evidence and fair technical communication within authority. A promise to prepare a dossier later is not a pass.

content.title: VUC049 | VUC049 senior delivery and assessment

lessons.title: VUC049 senior delivery and assessment
lessons.body: # VUC049 senior delivery and assessment

lessons.title: Learning plan and competence
lessons.body:
## Learning plan and competence

Planned100hours:76foundation/advanced hours excluding the earlier4h final,8senior instruction,4senior laboratories,6portfolio/practical defense,4comprehensive written final and2controlled oral assessment. Extend learning and actual practical time where needed. Prior exact valid outcome evidence may receive documented credit; attendance or an unrelated credential alone does not establish all tasks. No invented external experience credit.

Instructors/assessors need demonstrated competence in the methods and senior judgments evaluated. For the oral examination use two competent assessors; one must be independent of the primary instructor for an independent program decision. If independent review cannot be arranged, record that limitation and keep the senior award pending rather than claiming independent validation. This is a VNDRLY rule, not a representation of AMPP's panel procedure.

Retain all foundation/advanced actual equipment and specimen requirements: environmental/profile/salt/WFT/DFT/low-voltage tasks; logger, concrete methods, ultrasonic and eddy-current thickness, sacrificial adhesion/cross-section and hardness. Obtain competent supervision, safe identified specimens and private reference findings. No live blasting, high-voltage testing, production spray, confined-space entry or CP adjustment is authorized by this course. Physical requirements cannot be replaced with paper answers.

P01–40 retain their explicit tasks and four0–2 criteria. Require6/8 per station and corrected gaps, no unresolved critical errors. Mandatory physical tasks remain P05,P06,P09,P10,P12,P14,P15,P16,P19,P28,P30,P34,P35,P36. Senior P41–48 below require actual authored outputs/defense, not promises of later work. Demonstration/coaching and independent assessment are recorded separately.

lessons.title: P41 — Delegation matrix
lessons.body:
## P41 — Delegation matrix

Use F48/T49 plus a junior with steel DFT evidence and no destructive-test evidence. Learner assigns tasks and supervision with named escalation alternatives. Score actual competence matching, supervision constraints, authority boundaries and usable shift coverage.

lessons.title: P42 — Clause interpretation
lessons.body:
## P42 — Clause interpretation

Independently evaluate W17 and its revision/concession. Score raw arithmetic, correct statistic/limits, valid revision application and preserved original-versus-concession distinction.

lessons.title: P43 — Resource and sequence plan
lessons.body:
## P43 — Resource and sequence plan

Use W18 and changed shared-gauge constraint. Learner provides a timed schedule with assumptions and unresolved resource needs. Score complete workload, correct arithmetic, real concurrency constraints and no silent sampling waiver.

lessons.title: P44 — Containment interruption tabletop
lessons.body:
## P44 — Containment interruption tabletop

Use W19 outage and safe-work records. Learner separates immediate safety response, environmental evidence and coating impact. Score control recognition, safe access/restart, affected interval and bounded disposition. Do not physically create an unsafe outage.

lessons.title: P45 — Mechanism-based inquiry
lessons.body:
## P45 — Mechanism-based inquiry

Use soft-film record, correct ratio and excessive thickness. Learner builds an evidence/alternative-cause matrix and updates it after valid logger evidence. Score chemistry-informed hypotheses, discriminating evidence, preserved sample identity and revised inference without unsupported blame.

lessons.title: P46 — Process and measurement troubleshooting
lessons.body:
## P46 — Process and measurement troubleshooting

Use W20 and a safe de-energized apparatus diagram. Learner traces last-good/first-failed boundaries and identifies operator/manual responsibilities. Score safe sequence, affected scope, independent restart verification and prior-film evaluation. No pressurized adjustments by the learner.

lessons.title: P47 — Technical dispute role-play
lessons.body:
## P47 — Technical dispute role-play

Assessor plays contractor requesting altered raw reading and owner offering a concession. Learner explains facts and obtains proper disposition route. Score clear evidence, refusal to falsify, respectful escalation and accurate concession language.

lessons.title: P48 — Senior portfolio defense
lessons.body:
## P48 — Senior portfolio defense

Submit I49-C with actual foundation practical records and complete written outputs. Defend decisions under changed facts. Score integration/traceability, quantitative reasoning, scope/authority and responsive revision. Confidence of delivery cannot replace technical correctness.

lessons.title: Written final
lessons.body:
## Written final

48 cases,3 decisions each,288points;240minutes; calculator/coursebook allowed; keys, collaboration and coaching prohibited. Score each decision0–2:2 correct supported reasoning,1 safe incomplete,0 wrong/missing/unsafe. Require231/288 and at least4/6 in every domain, no unresolved critical error. Changed retake after targeted remediation; retain original work. Two unsuccessful changed attempts require individualized teaching and a fresh equivalent assessment.

lessons.title: Controlled oral examination
lessons.body:
## Controlled oral examination

Use the separate private six-case oral form and changed form, not I49-C rehearsal. Allow20min per case including preparation and clarification,120min total. For each case assess five criteria0–2: technical interpretation, quantitative/evidence accuracy, safety/authority, complete disposition/records, and response to changed facts. Require8/10 each case,48/60 total and no critical error. Both assessors independently score before reconciliation. Record each rationale; if disagreement affects pass, a competent independent reviewer resolves it from evidence or a fresh equivalent case, not seniority or simple averaging.

Critical errors include invented clauses/readings/history, unsafe work direction, concealed invalid results and unsupported blanket release. Neutral clarification may establish what the learner means; leading hints turn that item into coached practice and require a fresh assessment. Approved interpreters/access accommodations must not supply technical answers. Record actual spoken decisions through notes or consented recording under the applicable privacy process; do not invent an audio record.

lessons.title: Award and maintenance
lessons.body:
## Award and maintenance

Require96 corrected formative checks,20workbooks,three integrated dossiers,all48stations including actual physical evidence,written and oral passes before VNDRLY/U Senior Coating Inspection Preparation. Record version/hash, learner identity, actual dates/hours, prior credit, instruments, assessor competence/independence, raw scores, remediation and limitations. Without practical/oral evidence issue only an accurately scoped knowledge record or incomplete status. No actual learner qualification is asserted by authoring this package.

Recommended VNDRLY review24months or sooner after changed methods/nonuse/performance concern; external credential renewal follows its own rules. Appeals go to a competent reviewer independent of the disputed assessment where practicable. Do not claim AMPP senior certification, years of work experience, specialist design or unrestricted production authority.

Assessment form: learner___ version/hash___ station/case___ actual evidence___ criteria scores___ critical issue___ rationale___ changed response___ independent assessor1/date___ assessor2/date___ disagreement resolution___ outcome___


---

courses.title: VUC049 | VUC049 formative checks

content.title: VUC049 | VUC049 formative checks
content.description: Course completion records study only. Certification also requires the separately controlled examination and applicable observed assessments specified in the program. This VNDRLY/U curriculum counterpart does not award, replace, or claim accreditation by the external credential issuer.

lessons.title: VUC049 formative checks
lessons.body:
# VUC049 formative checks

Attempt before reading the response. Explain every correction, revisit its chapter/station and apply the changed case. These checks support instruction and do not replace the controlled final.

## Q01-L1

Does acceptable topcoat appearance prove substrate preparation?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Evidence is required from the preparation stage. Revisit Q01 and explain its changed case.

## Q01-L2

Who may approve a departure?

**Answer:** The designated authority under the project plan.

**Reason/remediation:** A basic inspection assignment is not unlimited design authority. Revisit Q01 and explain its changed case.

## Q02-L1

Does a coating restore lost metal strength?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Structural condition requires its own assessment. Revisit Q02 and explain its changed case.

## Q02-L2

Can a pit be dismissed because surrounding steel looks good?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Localized damage can be significant. Revisit Q02 and explain its changed case.

## Q03-L1

Does this course permit confined-space entry?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Actual entry controls and authorization remain required. Revisit Q03 and explain its changed case.

## Q03-L2

Is an injection wound minor because its opening is small?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Follow urgent medical response for suspected injection. Revisit Q03 and explain its changed case.

## Q04-L1

Does schedule pressure waive a hold?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Only the defined release process resolves it. Revisit Q04 and explain its changed case.

## Q04-L2

Can old readings be silently relabeled to a new revision?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Preserve chronology and assess change impact. Revisit Q04 and explain its changed case.

## Q05-L1

Are calibration and field verification identical?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** They serve different purposes. Revisit Q05 and explain its changed case.

## Q05-L2

How many micrometres in one mil?

**Answer:** 25.4.

**Reason/remediation:** Keep unit conversions explicit. Revisit Q05 and explain its changed case.

## Q06-L1

Which temperature enters the dew-point spread?

**Answer:** Substrate temperature minus dew point.

**Reason/remediation:** Air temperature alone is not the substrate value. Revisit Q06 and explain its changed case.

## Q06-L2

Does a passing spread override excessive RH?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** All specified conditions apply. Revisit Q06 and explain its changed case.

## Q07-L1

Can blasting automatically replace degreasing?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Contamination may be spread or embedded. Revisit Q07 and explain its changed case.

## Q07-L2

May an inspector remove structurally significant metal without approval?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Fabrication correction needs proper authority. Revisit Q07 and explain its changed case.

## Q08-L1

Are cleanliness and profile the same property?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Both require appropriate evidence. Revisit Q08 and explain its changed case.

## Q08-L2

Does water cleaning always create an abrasive profile?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Existing texture and method limits matter. Revisit Q08 and explain its changed case.

## Q09-L1

Should an already-corrected tape value have backing subtracted again?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Confirm instrument mode. Revisit Q09 and explain its changed case.

## Q09-L2

May an out-of-range tape reading be extrapolated?

**Answer:** Not without a valid approved method.

**Reason/remediation:** Use a suitable grade or method. Revisit Q09 and explain its changed case.

## Q10-L1

Can a visual check prove salts absent?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Use the specified valid test. Revisit Q10 and explain its changed case.

## Q10-L2

What is1µg/cm² in mg/m²?

**Answer:** 10mg/m².

**Reason/remediation:** Convert before comparison. Revisit Q10 and explain its changed case.

## Q11-L1

Are all epoxies interchangeable?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Actual formulation/service approval matters. Revisit Q11 and explain its changed case.

## Q11-L2

Does touch-dry prove service cure?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Cure requirements are separate. Revisit Q11 and explain its changed case.

## Q12-L1

Does thinner restart pot life?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Chemical reaction timing is not reset. Revisit Q12 and explain its changed case.

## Q12-L2

Can mass ratio be treated as volume ratio?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Need valid basis and instructions. Revisit Q12 and explain its changed case.

## Q13-L1

Can broad-panel WFT prove edge stripe completion?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Separate geometry/sequence evidence required. Revisit Q13 and explain its changed case.

## Q13-L2

Who changes application parameters?

**Answer:** Authorized personnel under approved instructions.

**Reason/remediation:** Inspector observations do not confer unrestricted process authority. Revisit Q13 and explain its changed case.

## Q14-L1

Is a comb interval an exact thickness?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Report bounded reading. Revisit Q14 and explain its changed case.

## Q14-L2

Does predicted DFT replace final measurement?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Prediction depends on assumptions and application. Revisit Q14 and explain its changed case.

## Q15-L1

Can any thickness probe measure any substrate?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Choose compatible physics/range. Revisit Q15 and explain its changed case.

## Q15-L2

Can total thickness prove each coat thickness?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Need appropriate layer evidence. Revisit Q15 and explain its changed case.

| Trace process faults and safe restart boundaries | Q46; B05 and actual equipment instructions | W20 | P46, Q46 checks/final, O6 |
| Defend ethical, bounded dispositions | Q47; B02/B06 | W17/W20 | P47, Q47 checks/final, O2/O6 |
| Integrate and revise a technical decision orally | Q48; B01/B02 | I49-C | P48, Q48 checks/final, O1–O6 |

Q01–40 retain their included outcome maps and practical stations. S49 numerical acceptance rules are fictional teaching specifications. No numerical rule is attributed to AMPP or a proprietary standard. External qualifications, work experience, legal duties and employer authorization are not replaced by a VNDRLY learning record.

lessons.title: Document control
lessons.body:
## Document control

Before delivery, the instructor checks source availability and changes relevant to the actual tasks. Record source edition/date, affected outcome, correction and material version. Do not silently substitute a new acceptance limit into an old exercise. If an actual project requires inaccessible clauses, obtain its authorized requirements before the job; the learning package cannot invent them.
