lessons.title: VUC052 facility applications and delivery
lessons.body: # VUC052 facility applications and delivery

lessons.title: Instructor preparation and delivery plan
lessons.body:
## Instructor preparation and delivery plan

Instructor: experienced facility-construction inspection practitioner, supported by competent civil, mechanical and electrical/instrument specialists for topics beyond personal competence. Do not present this course as specialist licensure. Establish learner readiness in industrial safety, drawings, units, arithmetic and factual reporting; supply prerequisite teaching before assessment. Explain supplied fictional criteria and how actual approved criteria would be obtained. Provide accessible text, enlarged drawings and response accommodations that preserve the measured outcome.

Plan 80 instructional hours: 24 foundation instruction/applications, 12 foundation stations and integrated case, 12 facility instruction/checks, 12 facility labs, 12 facility stations, 4 integrated facility review and 4 controlled final. Breaks and any additional remediation are outside this allocation. Actual attendance and competence are not asserted by this plan. Retain Q01–24, W01–08, I42 and P01–24 from the identified foundation. Do not administer its separate final as the VUC052 final; the combined 40-case examination replaces it.

Equipment: course files, calculator, F52 drawing cards, inert foundation/rebar/anchor and piping models, ruler/caliper/level, unpowered shaft/support model with dial or equivalent indicator, current-limited 4–20 mA simulator and compatible display, isolated continuity training circuit, appropriate meter, reference cards and blank forms. Instructor checks stable mounting, sharp edges, pinch points, instrument status and known reference values before use. No live process, pressure testing, energized mains, lifting, excavation, concrete chemicals or hazardous-area work is conducted. Required actual observed tasks are foundation P04/P07/P10/P16 plus facility P27/P32/P36/P38. Remote equivalents require supervised equipment and known references; otherwise mark practical outcomes pending. A quiz cannot replace those demonstrations.

lessons.title: F52 project packet and records
lessons.body:
## F52 project packet and records

F52 is a wholly synthetic pump-station project. Civil foundation F2 supports pump P52; line L52 connects the pump; transmitter PT52 feeds display DI52; electrical system E52 and grounding node G52 are separate dossier boundaries. Plot plan revision B supersedes A. Inspection plan ITP52 revision 2 requires the designated authority to release pre-pour, equipment placement and startup holds. The inspector records evidence and recommends disposition; the operator authorizes startup. All numerical criteria below are classroom-only.

Issue forms with these fields:
- Inspection: learner, date/time, system/tag, drawing/procedure revision, requirement, instrument/reference, actual observation, calculation, comparison, limitation, disposition owner and signature.
- NCR: ID, affected scope, requirement, observed deviation, immediate controls, proposed disposition, authorized decision, work evidence, reinspection, closure authority/date; preserve original failure.
- Hold register: ID, prerequisite, evidence reference, notified parties/time, witness status, release authority/date, restriction.
- Turnover index: required item, system/configuration, received revision, verified validity, gap, owner and closure reference.
- Learner assessment: station/domain, original response, scores, critical error, feedback, remediation, changed response and assessor/date.

Assessor uses the worked responses below for teaching, then changes the input and requires an individual response. Do not read the controlled final beforehand. Ask what evidence would change the decision and what remains outside the learner's authority.

For W09–16, score five dimensions 0–2: input identity, calculation/method, comparison, safe disposition and complete record. Pass 8/10 with no zero dimension or unresolved critical error. Foundation W01–08 retain their printed ten-point rubrics and require 8/10 each. Correct all formative responses with explanations; preserve original answers and targeted remediation. I42 requires 24/30 with at least 3/6 in each of its five dimensions. I52 has its separately stated twelve-point rubric. Learners may appeal a result with the disputed criterion and evidence; arrange review by another competent assessor where feasible without deleting the original decision. Keep assessment keys and personal records under the provider's actual access and retention controls; separate folders alone do not enforce security.

lessons.title: W09 — Survey and pre-pour release
lessons.body:
## W09 — Survey and pre-pour release

**Packet:** F2 target elevation 100.000 m, tolerance±0.010 m; measured 99.982 m. Dry density 1880 versus laboratory 2000 kg/m³, minimum 95%. Cover50±5 mm at 48/51/43 mm; anchor pitch 600±3 mm, measured 606 mm. Drawing A was used for the anchor template, while B is approved. Prepare the inspection and hold entries; calculate each deviation without combining unlike criteria.

**Worked response:** elevation−18 mm is 8 mm outside the low bound; compaction 94% is 1 percentage point low; 43 mm cover is 2 mm below 45; 606 mm pitch is 3 mm above 603. Revision mismatch is a separate applicability problem. Retain pre-pour hold and route findings to the responsible civil/design authority. No inspector-directed movement, added fill or revised tolerance is authorized by the arithmetic.

**Changed packet:** elevation 99.995 m, density 1900, cover 48/51/47, pitch 602, but no evidence that B was used. Numerical comparisons pass; reconcile the approved design before recommending hold release. Debrief why passing measurements do not cure a revision gap.

lessons.title: W10 — Concrete and grout dossier
lessons.body:
## W10 — Concrete and grout dossier

**Packet:** specimen rule mean≥30 MPa, none<27; results 31/29/32; specimen IDs map to F2 and the stated age/curing record. Grout base 2×1 m, depth 0.04 m, exclusions 0.01 m³, ordering allowance 10%. Calculate results and state what they establish.

**Worked response:** mean 30.6667 MPa and minimum 29 meet the fictional specimen rule. Net grout 0.07 m³; order 0.077 m³=77 L. Neither establishes actual grout cure, contact or permission to load. Review those named requirements and responsible release separately.

**Changed packet:** results 32/32/26, depth 0.05 m, specimen identity missing. Mean30 does not cancel 26<27; identity additionally blocks attribution. Net0.09 m³; 99 L with allowance. Do not prescribe structural repair or load release. Complete an NCR and list the required technical disposition and verification evidence.

lessons.title: W11 — Structure, preservation and equipment placement
lessons.body:
## W11 — Structure, preservation and equipment placement

**Packet:**24 structural connections, 22 valid records, 1 failed, 1 wrong ID. P52 preservation check day 4, 14-day interval, current day 20. Foundation hold remains open. Complete placement-readiness memo.

**Worked response:**91.6667% valid, 2 unresolved; preservation due 18 and 2 days overdue. Equipment placement remains held pending the specified foundation release and other applicable prerequisites. Do not backdate preservation or substitute factory acceptance for site readiness.

**Changed packet:** wrong ID validly reconciled, preservation condition assessed and documented, but a shipping opening is unprotected.23/24=95.8333% structural coverage, 1 connection open; new preservation issue independently unresolved. Require competent lifting and placement controls; no actual lift is performed in this course.

lessons.title: W12 — Support and piping effects
lessons.body:
## W12 — Support and piping effects

**Packet:** stable unpowered model references show parallel offset 0.04 mm before connection and 0.16 after; maximum 0.10. Twelve joint records include 10 valid, 1 missing and 1 wrong gasket. Record observations, comparisons and an evidence-based investigation request.

**Worked response:**offset change 0.12; final excess 0.06 mm. Two joints unresolved. Neither the offset change nor the gasket finding identifies every cause of machinery movement. Preserve the sequence, request competent piping/support review and verify final assembly after authorized corrections.

**Changed packet:**offset 0.08 mm after correction, gasket replaced, its final assembly verification absent and angular alignment absent. Offset alone passes; do not close the missing final-configuration evidence. Physically demonstrate repeated model readings under the assessor's safe setup, recording reference and resolution.

lessons.title: W13 — Test and reinstatement boundaries
lessons.body:
## W13 — Test and reinstatement boundaries

**Packet:**18 temporary blinds; 16 signed removals, 1 installed, 1 unknown. Pressure test report accepted for L52. PT52 removed during testing has no reinstatement entry. Draw a simple boundary register and classify unresolved evidence.

**Worked response:**2 blind entries unresolved, plus separate transmitter reinstatement evidence. Accepted pressure-test results do not close reinstatement. No operational release. Obtain safe authorized physical/accounting verification and preserve actual status.

**Changed packet:**unknown blind verified removed; 17/18 removals documented, 1 installed. PT52 installed but range mismatch 0–160 instead of 0–100 bar. The test/reinstatement and configuration gaps remain distinct. Do not operate valves or energize equipment to discover the answer.

lessons.title: W14 — Instrument signal and loop scope
lessons.body:
## W14 — Instrument signal and loop scope

**Packet:**PT52 required 0–100 bar at 4–20 mA; 12 mA injected, DI52 shows52 bar; fictional tolerance±1% span. Simulated output test bypasses sensor. Calculate expected/error and define the tested scope.

**Worked response:**fraction(12−4)/16=.5; expected 50 bar; error+2 bar=+2% span, 1 percentage point beyond limit. The output-path test does not prove sensor response. Preserve as-found and obtain approved adjustment/retest. Do not claim a full protective-function test.

**Changed packet:**16 mA, 74.5 bar display; expected 75, error−.5 bar=−.5% span, passes numerical criterion. Test override restoration unrecorded, so readiness remains open. On benign simulator demonstrate 4/12/20 mA, expected 0/50/100 bar, record actuals and return it to the designated safe state. No live process or protection is connected.

lessons.title: W15 — Classification and continuity evidence
lessons.body:
## W15 — Classification and continuity evidence

**Packet:**E52 has weatherproof marking only; approved area drawing requires classified-location suitability. G52 observed 0.18 Ω, lead 0.03, supplied maximum corrected 0.10 Ω. A temporary parallel bond may exist. Prepare separate electrical suitability and continuity findings.

**Worked response:**weatherproof evidence is insufficient for the specified classification; obtain qualified verification of device and installation. Corrected0.15 Ω exceeds by.05, but unknown parallel path additionally limits interpretation. Do not disconnect live bonds. The safe model exercise compares known paths only.

**Changed packet:**certificate adequate but installed cable entry differs; observed.11−.03=.08 Ω. Numerical continuity passes, installation discrepancy remains, and path configuration still must be verified. Neither reading proves full grounding, fault protection or CP design conformance.

lessons.title: W16 — Punch list and final handover
lessons.body:
## W16 — Punch list and final handover

**Packet:**8 punch items, 6 minor closed, 2 startup blockers open. Dossier20 required items, 19 files; 1 wrong revision and 1 wrong system among those 19. Prepare final readiness statement and accountable action list.

**Worked response:**punch closure 75%; valid dossier 17/20=85%, 3 unsupported. State both blockers and exact missing records; no unconditional operational release. Avoid treating an impressive file count as verified system evidence.

**Changed packet:**one blocker closes and one minor reopens; closure still 75%, risk changed. Corrected files bring 19/20=95%, but remaining item is reinstatement. Preserve that restriction and responsible owner. The final report should distinguish verified construction items, open technical dispositions and operator startup authorization.

lessons.title: Facility practical stations P25–P40
lessons.body:
## Facility practical stations P25–P40

Apply the foundation five-dimension rubric: identity, method/calculation, interpretation, safe authority and traceable communication, each 0–2. Pass8/10 with no zero and no unresolved critical error. Critical errors include fabricated evidence, unsafe live-work directions, concealed failures or unsupported operational release. All stations require individual records. Physical stations marked **actual** cannot be passed from supplied answers alone.

| Station | Setup and required performance | Expected evidence and changed task |
|---|---|---|
| P25 | Four-package F52 interface map; construct hold register | Separate factory/site boundaries; change civil report to wrong tag and retain applicability gap |
| P26 | W09 survey/density cards; calculate and locate findings | Units/datum/lift identified; use changed passing numbers with unresolved revision |
| P27 **actual** | Stable inert cover/anchor model with assessor-known dimensions | Measure at least three cover locations and pitch; compare fictional criteria; assessor changes one position for remeasurement |
| P28 | W10 specimen identity and curing cards | Mean/individual rule separated; change one result/identity and record NCR |
| P29 | Scaled grout sketch | Net/exclusion/allowance shown; changed depth computed; no release from volume |
| P30 | Twenty-four connection index | Valid coverage and open IDs correct; reconcile one ID without closing failure |
| P31 | Equipment receipt/preservation cards | Overdue calculation and condition separate; introduce missing cap |
| P32 **actual** | Stable unpowered alignment model, known reference, dial or equivalent | Record repeat readings before/after safe assessor change; distinguish offset/angle and do not force connections |
| P33 | Twelve-joint packet and inert component labels | Identify gasket/record gaps; after replacement request final assembly verification |
| P34 | Blind/register/boundary cards | Account for all eighteen; change unknown status, retain installed blind and PT52 gap |
| P35 | Tag/datasheet/configuration cards | Range/identity mismatch explained; change configuration but retain materials question |
| P36 **actual** | Current-limited simulator and display, isolated from process | Demonstrate 4/12/20 mA checks, record as-found and scope; change readout scale, diagnose without unsafe adjustment |
| P37 | Classification drawing/certificate/entry photos | Match suitability and installation; adequate certificate with wrong entry remains open |
| P38 **actual** | Isolated low-voltage model/meter, known lead/path references | Measure lead and path, correct reading, state limit; assessor adds benign parallel path and learner identifies interpretation limit |
| P39 | Eight-item punch register | Named blockers survive percentage; one closes/one reopens, update consequence |
| P40 | Twenty-item turnover index | Validity rather than file count, restrictions and owner; changed nineteen valid still not unconditional release |

For physical stations the instructor records the actual reference dimensions/readings and tolerances before the learner begins. Use instrument resolution adequate to distinguish the exercise criteria. Repeat a discrepant reading and explain uncertainty; do not silently round across a limit. Stop any unsafe equipment setup. Assess accessible equivalent performance against the same evidence requirements.

lessons.title: I52 — Integrated station turnover conference
lessons.body:
## I52 — Integrated station turnover conference

Give each learner W09–16 original packets together. Require a one-page readiness memo, system map, hold register, NCR list and turnover index. The learner must identify the pre-pour deviations, separate specimen/grout evidence, preserve structural and preservation gaps, explain alignment/joint findings, keep reinstatement open, diagnose signal scaling, refer electrical suitability and report the two startup blockers. There is no safe “all accepted” response to this original packet.

Then issue all changed packets. The learner updates only evidence actually resolved, preserving remaining revision, specimen, angular/final assembly, blind, override, cable entry and turnover issues as applicable. Ask which observations were personally demonstrated versus supplied. Expected conference conclusion: report verified portions and exact restrictions; the operator and competent technical authorities retain their decisions.

Score six criteria 0–2: boundary map, calculations, traceability, prioritization, authority/safety, communication. Pass10/12 with no zero and no unresolved critical error. For reassessment, use fresh tag identifiers and alternate measurements of the same difficulty; keep original response and remediation. Foundation I42 is also required, evaluated under its existing rubric. No actual construction completion is asserted by a classroom exercise.

lessons.title: Final, reassessment and award
lessons.body:
## Final, reassessment and award

Controlled final: 40 original cases, 3 decisions each, 240 points, 240 minutes. Calculator/coursebook allowed; keys, collaboration and outside assistance prohibited. Pass192/240 and≥4/6 in each domain, with no unresolved critical error. Each decision: 2 correct with supported reasoning, 1 safe incomplete, 0 missing/wrong/unsafe. A safety-critical failure requires teaching and observed changed response; a high total cannot erase it. Give changed cases only after remediation, without their keys. After two unsuccessful changed attempts, provide an individualized learning plan and a fresh supervised equivalent assessment. Preserve every attempt.

Learner award requires all 40 chapters/checks, 16 labs, 40 stations, both integrated cases and final passed, including eight mandatory actual stations. Record attendance, equipment/reference, assessor identity, results, limitations and version hash. Reused prior learning must be documented against the same outcomes and current evidence; no automatic credit from a similarly named credential. Issue “VNDRLY/U Pipeline Facility Construction Inspection — original training and assessment completion,” not API1184. Apply a24-month VNDRLY review interval and earlier review after material changes, extended absence or demonstrated gap; this is not an API validity rule. Employer appointment and specialist authorizations remain separate.

content.title: VUC052 | VUC052 explained formative checks

lessons.title: VUC052 explained formative checks
lessons.body:
# VUC052 explained formative checks

Attempt before reading the answer. Correct errors with an explanation, revisit the matching chapter/station and apply its changed case. These checks do not replace the controlled final.

## Q01-L1

Can you sign witnessed if absent?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason and remediation:** Record actual evidence source. Revisit Q01 and its practical station.

## Q01-L2

Does a later report change what you observed?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason and remediation:** It supplies separate evidence. Revisit Q01 and its practical station.

## Q02-L1

Are gas and liquid rules interchangeable?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason and remediation:** Establish applicability. Revisit Q02 and its practical station.

## Q02-L2

Does a redline prove approval?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason and remediation:** Authorization and installed evidence are separate. Revisit Q02 and its practical station.

## Q03-L1

Does ordered equipment prove readiness?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason and remediation:** Actual availability/function matters. Revisit Q03 and its practical station.

## Q03-L2

Why inspect before concealment?

**Answer:** Evidence may become inaccessible.

**Reason and remediation:** Plan holds and records before burial. Revisit Q03 and its practical station.

## Q04-L1

What is metric2+150?

**Answer:** 2150 m under that convention.

**Reason and remediation:** Check station system. Revisit Q04 and its practical station.

## Q04-L2

Does coordinate without datum locate reliably?

**Answer:** Not necessarily.

**Reason and remediation:** Reference system matters. Revisit Q04 and its practical station.

## Q05-L1

Does verbal access clear every permit?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason and remediation:** Environmental/crossing requirements remain. Revisit Q05 and its practical station.

## Q05-L2

Can unexpected sensitive findings be moved casually?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason and remediation:** Use the actual response plan. Revisit Q05 and its practical station.

## Q06-L1

Does no pipe at guessed depth mean clear?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason and remediation:** Location uncertainty remains. Revisit Q06 and its practical station.

## Q06-L2

Are abandoned-looking lines harmless?

**Answer:** Not established.

**Reason and remediation:** Identify/control actual facility. Revisit Q06 and its practical station.

## Q07-L1

Does diameter prove grade?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason and remediation:** Identity/specification evidence needed. Revisit Q07 and its practical station.

## Q07-L2

Can PMI alone prove all properties?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason and remediation:** Chemistry does not establish all required properties. Revisit Q07 and its practical station.

## Q08-L1

Does coating repair fix a gouge?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason and remediation:** Metal damage is independent. Revisit Q08 and its practical station.

## Q08-L2

May inspection require standing below a load?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason and remediation:** Use safe access and qualified lifting controls. Revisit Q08 and its practical station.

## Q09-L1

Does shallow depth guarantee safe entry?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason and remediation:** Actual hazards/protection must be evaluated. Revisit Q09 and its practical station.

## Q09-L2

Does ladder resolve collapse risk?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason and remediation:** Egress and protection differ. Revisit Q09 and its practical station.

## Q10-L1

Does an ovality number clear a wrinkle?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason and remediation:** Separate requirements apply. Revisit Q10 and its practical station.

## Q10-L2

Can force-fit automatically be accepted?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason and remediation:** Stress/geometry need approved evaluation. Revisit Q10 and its practical station.

## Q11-L1

Does welder qualification qualify WPS?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason and remediation:** Separate evidence. Revisit Q11 and its practical station.

## Q11-L2

Can actual transition be ignored?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason and remediation:** Applicable procedure support must match. Revisit Q11 and its practical station.

## Q12-L1

Can report17 clear weld71?

**Answer:** Not without correct identity.

**Reason and remediation:** Traceability is essential. Revisit Q12 and its practical station.
