lessons.title: VNDRLY/U Manual Ultrasonic Examination — Integrated Weld Assessment
lessons.body:
# VNDRLY/U Manual Ultrasonic Examination — Integrated Weld Assessment

VUC063 · Original instruction · 2026-11-18

lessons.title: Scope and entry competence
lessons.body:
## Scope and entry competence

This program integrates conventional manual UT setup, weld detection/characterization, length and applicable surface-connected crack-height measurement, and traceable reporting. It addresses the separately cataloged current manual-examination scope rather than repeating only the legacy detection course. Single- or dual-element techniques must be suitable for the actual task. Phased array, TOFD and other modes are not conferred by this award.

Require documented foundational UT competence, weld geometry, safe equipment handling and practical sizing prerequisites. The instructor verifies these before independent assessment. VNDRLY materials are original training, not API-approved instruction, employer certification or authority to accept production equipment. Current public API documents contain conflicting terminology and height-reporting sentences; the source register identifies those conflicts. The training criteria here are explicit original rules and do not silently resolve external exam rules on API's behalf. [S63-01]

lessons.title: Q01 — Turn an assignment into an examination plan
lessons.body:
## Q01 — Turn an assignment into an examination plan

Read the scope as a set of required outputs: identify the component, establish examination volume, find reportable responses, characterize them, locate endpoints, measure applicable height and document limits. Do not treat a successful detection scan as completion when sizing or records remain missing. Separate inspection findings from acceptance/disposition authority.

Create a task matrix linking each required output to technique, reference, evidence and responsible person. If a requested quantity is undefined, resolve its meaning before measuring. A complete report cannot be assembled by attaching unrelated readings after the fact.

**Worked:** plate and pipe examinations plus four crack bars are assigned. The learner scans plate and pipe but leaves the bars blank. Detection work may be valid, but the integrated task is incomplete. **Changed:** a bar is inaccessible. Record the limitation and seek a suitable authorized arrangement; do not enter zero as an assumed size. P01 uses an output/evidence matrix.

lessons.title: Q02 — Readiness, identity and safe handling
lessons.body:
## Q02 — Readiness, identity and safe handling

Confirm material, dimensions, geometry, technique revision and equipment applicability. Check safe support, pipe restraint, cable/connector condition, sharp edges, couplant/SDS and spill management. Use only cool, depressurized training components. This course does not authorize hot or live-plant examination, electrical repair or hazardous access.

Record actual sample aliases and orientation before moving equipment. A correct result attached to the wrong component is an invalid report. If labels conflict, stop the identity-dependent task and resolve the discrepancy without guessing.

**Worked:** safe sample has two inconsistent identifiers on the worksheet and tag. Reconcile identity before scanning. **Changed:** identity is corrected but pipe can roll. Secure the arrangement first. P02 requires actual observations and a readiness record that does not substitute a signature for the checks.

lessons.title: Q03 — Build the setup and preserve its identity
lessons.body:
## Q03 — Build the setup and preserve its identity

Inventory instrument/software, probe, wedge, cable and reference block. Record configuration values used for each method and link every result to that setup identifier. A saved file is an aid, not evidence that its assumptions match the connected hardware or actual part. Demonstrate setup from documented requirements and verify independently.

Use distinct setup IDs for materially different configurations. When changing hardware or mode, determine which checks must be repeated. Never relabel an old setup as current without actual evidence. Maintain the original record to support later review.

**Worked:** setup S1 used a different wedge than the current one, but the operator retains S1 on all reports. Create the correct configuration record and perform required verification. **Changed:** only a display color changes with no measurement dependency. Record the change as appropriate without pretending it creates a new physical calibration. P03 distinguishes substantive configuration changes from cosmetic ones.

lessons.title: Q04 — Single versus dual-element behavior
lessons.body:
## Q04 — Single versus dual-element behavior

A dual probe has separate transmitting and receiving elements with a geometry-dependent path. It cannot be assumed to behave like a straight single-element pulse-echo probe over every thickness. Manufacturer guidance identifies possible thin-section nonlinearity and the need to verify the relevant range. [S63-02]

Set the correct operating mode and use the approved probe-specific measurement convention. Verify actual references across the intended range. A good thick-reference result does not prove accurate thin-section readings. Do not apply a generic manual correction unless the technique validates it.

**Worked:** known 4 and 12 mm references read 4.6 and 12.1 mm. Errors +0.6 and +0.1 show the thin point is problematic against fictional ±0.3 mm training checks. **Changed:** a supported correction/mode brings both within criterion. Record actual verification and the limited demonstrated range. P04 includes genuine probe/mode comparison on safe references.

lessons.title: Q05 — Velocity, zero and path verification
lessons.body:
## Q05 — Velocity, zero and path verification

Distance depends on timing, velocity and delay. For a simple material-only pulse-echo path, S=vt/2. Calibration establishes the relationship; reference verification independently tests it. Periodic instrument certification does not replace a setup-specific calibration. Manufacturer teaching distinguishes these activities. [S63-03]

Use identified references spanning the relevant range. Preserve raw readings and actual settings. If a reference fails, correct the cause and assess affected measurements instead of adjusting only the final reported value.

**Worked:** corrected 18 µs at 3.2 mm/µs gives path 28.8 mm. **Changed:** raw 21 µs includes 3 µs delay; using raw time gives 33.6 mm, 4.8 mm high. These calculations explain a simple case; they do not override dual-path or instrument-specific corrections.

lessons.title: Q06 — Index, angle and physical coordinates
lessons.body:
## Q06 — Index, angle and physical coordinates

Establish beam index and refracted angle using the approved method. Define datum, positive direction and weld centerline separately from wedge position. For a flat first-leg path S at θ from normal, normal depth is S cosθ and surface distance S sinθ. The correct formula with a wrong index still gives a wrong location.

Record front-edge offsets only with their signed direction and actual measurement. Do not move plotted findings to make them look plausible. A mismatch is a reason to examine geometry or setup, not to invent coordinates.

**Worked:** path 36 mm at 60° gives depth 18 mm and offset 31.1769 mm. **Changed:** recorded lateral coordinate is known to be 2 mm too high from an index mistake. Subtract 2 from that coordinate traceably; do not alter the independent depth calculation. P06 requires actual index/angle verification and a relocated reference.

lessons.title: Q07 — Legs, thickness and curved geometry
lessons.body:
## Q07 — Legs, thickness and curved geometry

Identify the sound leg before calculating location. In a flat plate's second leg, normal depth is 2 t−S cosθ within that leg's range. For curved parts, use the applicable validated geometric correction/model and probe fit. A plate approximation is not automatically valid because the wall is thin.

Plan the examination against actual geometry, crown and access. Determine whether intended scan positions are physically reachable and whether the method can resolve the target feature. Record uncovered scope explicitly.

**Worked:** t=24 mm, S=72 mm at 60° gives unfolded travel 36 mm and second-leg depth 12 mm. **Changed:** the part is a small pipe with rocking wedge contact. The flat calculation alone cannot validate the examination. Establish proper contact/model and repeat required checks before use.

lessons.title: Q08 — Reference, scanning and evaluation sensitivity
lessons.body:
## Q08 — Reference, scanning and evaluation sensitivity

Reference sensitivity provides a reproducible response basis. Scanning sensitivity may differ from evaluation sensitivity under the procedure. Record both and return to the required evaluation basis before comparing an indication with a reporting criterion. More gain is not more physical flaw height.

Avoid clipping and distinguish peak validity from noise. Use applicable path-dependent compensation only as the technique permits. A response level without setup and reference context cannot be interpreted reliably.

**Worked:** valid 20% and 80% responses have ratio 0.25, or −12.0412 dB relative to the reference. **Changed:** evaluation performed at an unrecorded extra gain. Reestablish the required basis rather than comparing incompatible values. This is original amplitude arithmetic, not a claim that these percentages are universal reporting limits.

lessons.title: Q09 — Complete directional and contact coverage
lessons.body:
## Q09 — Complete directional and contact coverage

Translate the volume and likely orientations into an actual movement plan. Record sides, directions, scan limits, indexing, contact verification and interruptions. A single pass may not interrogate transverse features or regions shadowed by another response. Use the technique's required directions rather than convenience.

After lift-off, resume with a documented overlap or repeat the affected region. Do not count a clean display during loss of coupling as sound material. Record any unexamined interval even if the rest of the report is complete.

**Worked:** 240 mm assigned length, 180 mm demonstrably covered, leaves 60 mm and 25% unexamined. **Changed:** the remaining interval is scanned validly. Add its evidence and update scope without deleting the original interruption. P09 observes the actual scan rather than inferring coverage from elapsed time.

lessons.title: Q10 — Discriminate geometry and reportable findings
lessons.body:
## Q10 — Discriminate geometry and reportable findings

Compare responses with known boundaries, root/crown, mismatch and beam behavior. Use approved movements and plotting to evaluate each candidate. A root echo can be geometry or coexist with a relevant feature; one explanation cannot erase all nearby responses. Report supported findings even when precise type remains unresolved.

False calls matter alongside misses. Calling every echo a crack is not cautious competence, and dismissing every awkward echo as geometry is not efficient examination. Preserve reasoning and uncertainty so follow-up is directed accurately.

**Worked:** one response tracks known root geometry; another persists at a distinct position. Evaluate separately. **Changed:** the second is shown to be another known boundary by corroboration. Revise the interpretation with its evidence; do not erase the earlier evaluation history. P10 includes sound and flawed teaching regions.

lessons.title: Q11 — Characterize connection and feature type
lessons.body:
## Q11 — Characterize connection and feature type

Distinguish surface-connected from embedded conditions using actual location and corroborating evidence. Report the supported feature category, not merely the most familiar name. Planar, volumetric and laminar responses have different interpretation and coverage implications; waveform shape alone is not a universal classifier.

Where views conflict, revisit setup, geometry and interpretation. Do not average categorical disagreements or claim certainty because a dropdown requires a choice. Use the provided uncertainty/reporting path and technical review.

**Worked:** one permitted view supports an embedded planar response, another suggests surface connection. Investigate and retain both observations. **Changed:** verified evidence resolves a far-surface connection. Record the resulting classification and determine whether the assigned height method applies. P11 links characterization to the next required measurement.

lessons.title: Q12 — Endpoints and length are traceable measurements
lessons.body:
## Q12 — Endpoints and length are traceable measurements

Use the approved endpoint criterion and a consistent datum/direction. Record start, stop, units, sensitivity and probe orientation. Response length is method-dependent; it is not automatically an exact physical boundary. Gross oversizing may wrongly implicate adjacent sound regions.

Check raw endpoints before entering the total. A typed length that disagrees with stop minus start needs resolution. Preserve the source observations and correct the report traceably.

**Worked:** start 48 mm, stop 83 mm: length 35 mm. **Changed:** valid revised stop 79 mm gives 31 mm, a 4 mm reduction. State why the measurement changed. P12 requires actual endpoint demonstration and relocation rather than a worksheet-only subtraction.

lessons.title: Q13 — Define height, tip depth and ligament
lessons.body:
## Q13 — Define height, tip depth and ligament

For a flat far-surface-connected feature, height h=t−d where t is local thickness and d is normal depth to the established tip from the scanning surface. Near-surface remaining ligament is d. Surface-connected on the scanning side or embedded features require their applicable definition/method. Do not label a path length as depth or a ligament as height.

Use the actual local thickness where the feature is measured. Nominal drawing values may differ. Establish tip identity before subtraction; mathematics cannot prove the echo represents the crack boundary.

**Worked:** local 25 mm, valid far-surface tip depth 17 mm gives height 8 mm and ligament 17 mm. **Changed:** local thickness is actually 24 mm at that position: height 7 mm. Record the local basis and revise without changing the measured tip depth arbitrarily.

lessons.title: Q14 — Find and corroborate a tip response
lessons.body:
## Q14 — Find and corroborate a tip response

A tip can produce a weaker diffracted response distinct from a base/corner echo. Manufacturer explanation supports geometry-based location, but actual identification needs the validated technique and corroboration. [S63-04] Do not select an arbitrary weak echo or the brightest part of the display as the tip.

Follow permitted movements and verify consistency with the actual geometry. If the response cannot be uniquely identified, record sizing unresolved and obtain a suitable method rather than inventing a precise number. A detection procedure is not automatically a sizing procedure.

**Worked:** weak candidate is inconsistent across permitted positions. Height remains unsupported. **Changed:** repeated observations establish the same physical tip. Save those actual records and calculate using verified geometry. P14 uses known teaching samples before blind bars.

lessons.title: Q15 — Multiple tips and maximum height
lessons.body:
## Q15 — Multiple tips and maximum height

Scan the complete assigned feature and retain position-specific thickness/tip evidence. A feature can vary in height or have multiple branches. Select the greatest supported height under the defined method, not the mean or the smallest plausible value. A candidate proven geometric must be removed from interpretation with a traceable reason.

Distinguish maximum measured value from whole-feature maximum when coverage or interpretation remains unresolved. A confident result at one point does not fill a gap elsewhere.

**Worked:** in 25 mm local thickness, valid tip depths 18 and 15 mm yield heights 7 and 10 mm; maximum 10. **Changed:** 15 mm response is established as geometry. The 7 mm result remains supported only with valid remaining tip identity and full coverage. P15 requires an actual position/height table and interpretation history.

lessons.title: Q16 — Reportability rules and conflicting instructions
lessons.body:
## Q16 — Reportability rules and conflicting instructions

Read the actual applicable reporting instructions, including whether a boundary value is included and which feature types require which quantities. Distinguish a reporting threshold from an acceptance criterion. If source documents conflict, identify the conflict and obtain authoritative clarification for that external examination or job; do not silently choose the least demanding rule.

For this course, the instructor supplies explicit S63 training reporting rules and validated specimen criteria. They are original training requirements, not a substitute for a proprietary standard. Record an unmeasurable required quantity as pending, not zero or not applicable without basis.

**Worked:** a fictional rule says length at least 6 mm; a 6.0 mm feature is included. **Changed:** a different approved rule says greater than 6 mm; exact equality is excluded under that rule, assuming measurement evidence resolves the boundary. Do not mix the two wordings or ignore uncertainty.

lessons.title: Q17 — Electronic records and setup links
lessons.body:
## Q17 — Electronic records and setup links

Every reported finding must link to specimen, actual setup, calibration and source observations. Validate required fields, units and start/stop arithmetic before exporting. A filled form can still be wrong if dropdowns, defaults or copied setup numbers do not match the evidence.

Inspect the exported report itself: rows, symbols, decimals, units and limits must remain visible. Preserve source records and a traceable version. A non-editable export does not prove the data are correct, and a successful save message does not prove all fields survived.

**Worked:** three indications use S2, but one row defaults to S1. Correct the link before release. **Changed:** export clips the limitation column. Repair/export and inspect again; do not deliver an apparently complete report that hides unresolved scope. P17 requires actual record entry and export inspection.

lessons.title: Q18 — Drift, uncertainty and re-examination
lessons.body:
## Q18 — Drift, uncertainty and re-examination

Verify at required intervals and after relevant configuration changes. Determine which results depend on a failed check. Preserve failures, correct the cause and repeat affected work under the procedure. Later success cannot automatically validate earlier records.

Use independent reference truth and a prior uncertainty/decision rule. Consistent readings may share bias. Do not invent an uncertainty allowance or round a failed physical result into a pass. Escalate an unresolved basis and document pending work.

**Worked:** five specimens between last valid and failed check; three validly repeated leaves two unresolved absent supported disposition. **Changed:** a setup change affected only a documented subset. Bound the scope using evidence, not convenience, and record why unaffected results remain valid. P18 includes actual controlled recovery.

lessons.title: Q19 — Independent performance measures
lessons.body:
## Q19 — Independent performance measures

Keep detection, false calls, characterization, positioning, endpoints and height outcomes separate. Denominators must be explicit. A learner cannot offset poor sizing by detecting everything or offset false calls with a high written score. Protected specimen truth must be independently supported and suitable for the announced tolerances.

Written answers test reasoning; blind practical tests actual work. Unknown specimens must be technically resolvable under the approved technique. Do not make a specimen impossible and then penalize honest limitations as though the method had been validated.

**Worked:** 11 of 12 flaws detected gives 91.6667%; one false call in 24 sound regions gives 4.1667%. **Changed:** four sizing bars are required but one has no valid value. The integrated practical remains incomplete regardless of the detection rate. P19 requires complete category-by-category scoring.

lessons.title: Q20 — Handover, remediation and credential boundary
lessons.body:
## Q20 — Handover, remediation and credential boundary

Deliver the supported examination result, clear limitations and linked evidence to the authorized recipient. Do not declare production acceptance or remaining life from a training measurement. Record actual demonstrated scope and any method/geometry limits. External certification requires its own authorized process.

After failure, identify whether the cause is setup, access, interpretation, sizing, records or integrity. Teach the cause and reassess with changed tasks/specimens. Preserve attempts and allow competent review. No learner completion is issued for missing actual performance or invented records.

**Worked:** all written answers pass but one required actual bar was never scanned. Practical remains pending. **Changed:** changed independent set is completed after remediation. Record that evidence and the training award, without retroactively claiming the original attempt passed. I63 closes the integrated learner task.


---

courses.title: VUC063 | VUC063 integrated manual UT delivery

content.title: VUC063 | VUC063 integrated manual UT delivery
content.description: Course completion records study only. Certification also requires the separately controlled examination and applicable observed assessments specified in the program. This VNDRLY/U curriculum counterpart does not award, replace, or claim accreditation by the external credential issuer.

lessons.title: VUC063 integrated manual UT delivery
lessons.body: # VUC063 integrated manual UT delivery

lessons.title: Instructor, schedule and equipment
lessons.body:
## Instructor, schedule and equipment

Plan 64 hours: 16 instruction/checks, 10 labs, 22 supervised stations, 12 integrated practice/assessment and 4 final/review. Breaks/additional remediation are extra. This is VNDRLY's original teaching plan, not an external mandated duration. Instructor must be competent in the actual conventional single/dual-element techniques, weld examination, applicable height sizing and assessment. The responsible UT technical authority approves actual procedures, reference truth and decision rules.

Diagnostic: identify specimen/datum, distinguish height/ligament, calculate first/second-leg location and path, safely establish actual instrument setup, demonstrate reference calibration and explain when a tip is unresolved. Teach prerequisite gaps before scored specialist work. Enlarge displays, provide accessible benches and equivalent answer formats without waiving actual performance. Demonstrate on known samples, then change samples and setup conditions for practice.

Provide conventional flaw detector with appropriate single/dual-element capabilities, approved probes/wedges/cables, identified calibration references, manufacturer manuals, safe couplant/SDS, ruler/plotting aids, removable markers, stable cool plate/pipe weld samples, validated crack-sizing bars and a training computer/form export system. Restrain pipes and heavy samples, inspect cables/edges and clean spills. No energized, pressurized, hot or hazardous-access field work is authorized by these exercises. Report actual equipment and observations only.

lessons.title: S63 specimen and technique plan
lessons.body:
## S63 specimen and technique plan

Teaching set contains sound/geometric examples, planar and volumetric conditions, lamination/access limitations and known surface-connected crack bars. Blind A and changed B each include plate/pipe weld regions with twelve validated reportable flaws and twenty-four validated sound regions, plus four resolvable far-surface-connected sizing bars across two thickness groups and flush/retained-crown conditions. Keep actual locations/counts and bar truth protected during attempts. These are procurement/design requirements, not claims that hardware has been obtained.

Authority establishes independent truth, location/endpoints/height and uncertainty, verifies technique reportability/resolution and ensures meaningful sound-region scoring. Exclude ambiguous or unresolvable specimens from scored sets until validated; use difficult examples separately to teach honest limitations. Each flaw has a unique grading region and clear match rules. No external protected exam samples or memorized answers may be used.

Actual technique sheet: material/geometry/thickness; instrument/software/probe/wedge/cable; single/dual mode and relevant path treatment; velocity/zero/index/angle; references and range; reference/scanning/evaluation sensitivity; contact/directional coverage; interpretation/endpoints; applicable tip/height method; units/datum; reporting rules; verification intervals/recovery; data-record/export instructions. Use actual manufacturer operations and authority-approved techniques. Saved files do not replace independent setup demonstration.

Fictional VNDRLY S63 performance: required depth references within ±0.3 mm; detect at least 11/12 reportable flaws including every predesignated critical planar feature; at most one false call among twenty-four sound regions; characterize at least 90% of detected flaws (required count rounded upward); every detected flaw's position and technique-defined endpoints within ±5 mm of validated truth; all four bar heights within ±1.0 mm; valid setup, complete coverage and coherent records. Authority must establish suitably smaller reference uncertainty and conservative decision rule before delivery. These are original training criteria, not API exam or production acceptance rules.

S63 reporting instructions for this course: report every validated indication meeting the supplied technique's response criterion and length at least 6 mm; record indication type, connection where supported, datum-based start/stop/length and limitations. Height is required for the four designated far-surface-connected sizing bars; optional weld-height work must be explicitly assigned with a suitable technique. Do not import conflicting external height sentences into this defined exercise. A required but unmeasurable value is pending, not zero.

lessons.title: W01 — Plan, identity and safety
lessons.body:
## W01 — Plan, identity and safety

Input: plate/pipe work and four bars assigned; one worksheet has conflicting sample ID and pipe is unsecured. Worked: build the output/evidence matrix, reconcile identity, secure sample before physical work; unscanned bars remain incomplete. Changed: identity resolved but one bar inaccessible. Record limitation, seek validated arrangement and keep value pending. Submit actual readiness observations and task matrix. Instructor rejects completed-looking rows unsupported by examination.

lessons.title: W02 — Configuration and probe mode
lessons.body:
## W02 — Configuration and probe mode

Input: old S1 uses another wedge; dual-probe references 4/12 mm read 4.6/12.1. Worked: actual setup needs correct identity/checks; errors +0.6/+0.1 against fictional ±0.3 mean first fails. Changed: validated correction makes reference results 4.1/12.2, errors +0.1/+0.2. Record actual verified range, not a universal dual-probe claim. Learner performs safe hardware/mode setup and independent checks; demonstrate differences without using inappropriate generic corrections.

lessons.title: W03 — Path, index and first-leg geometry
lessons.body:
## W03 — Path, index and first-leg geometry

Input: raw 21 µs includes 3 µs delay at 3.2 mm/µs; separate path 36 mm at 60°. Worked: corrected path 28.8 versus raw 33.6, error 4.8; separate ray depth 18 and offset 31.1769. Changed: positional coordinate known 2 mm high due to wrong index. Correct it by −2 with signed evidence; do not alter depth. Submit actual calibration/index checks plus labeled calculations, clearly distinguishing the separate cases.

lessons.title: W04 — Leg, curvature and sensitivity
lessons.body:
## W04 — Leg, curvature and sensitivity

Input: t = 24 mm, S = 72 mm at 60°; valid amplitudes 20%/80%. Worked: unfolded 36 mm, second-leg depth 12; ratio 0.25 gives −12.0412 dB. Changed: small pipe rocks under wedge and extra evaluation gain is unrecorded. Establish valid fit/model and restore documented sensitivity before reporting. Learner physically demonstrates reference/contact checks; arithmetic alone does not validate a curved examination.

lessons.title: W05 — Coverage and geometry discrimination
lessons.body:
## W05 — Coverage and geometry discrimination

Input: assigned 240 mm, actual 180 mm covered; distinct second response near known root geometry. Worked: 60 mm/25% remains; evaluate responses separately with actual evidence. Changed: missing interval scanned validly and second response corroborated as geometry. Add actual coverage and interpretation records without deleting uncertainty history. Instructor observes scan directions and contact, not just elapsed scanning time.

lessons.title: W06 — Characterization and endpoints
lessons.body:
## W06 — Characterization and endpoints

Input: conflicting embedded/surface-connected interpretation; endpoints 48/83 mm. Worked: length 35 mm, but characterization requires resolution. Changed: verified far-surface connection, revised valid stop 79 mm yields 31 mm, 4 mm shorter. Record evidence and endpoint criterion; decide whether assigned height method applies. Learner performs actual characterization and endpoint work on suitable known specimens.

lessons.title: W07 — Height and tip identity
lessons.body:
## W07 — Height and tip identity

Input: local 25 mm, valid tip 17 mm; separate weak candidate fails corroboration. Worked: first height 8, ligament 17; second sizing unresolved. Changed: local thickness 24 gives 7 mm for the established tip; repeated valid observations identify the other tip. Keep local basis and actual tip evidence separate. Learner demonstrates tip identification on known bars before blind assessment; no arbitrary weak-echo selection.

lessons.title: W08 — Maximum and reporting boundary
lessons.body:
## W08 — Maximum and reporting boundary

Input: local 25 mm, established tip depths 18/15 mm; fictional reporting rule at least 6 mm. Worked: heights 7/10, maximum 10; length 6.0 included under that wording. Changed: 15 mm response proven geometric; approved comparison rule says greater than 6 mm. Revise supported size with history and treat equality according to the actual rule, recognizing uncertainty. Do not transfer the comparison rule into S63's assigned reporting requirement.

lessons.title: W09 — Electronic record and recovery
lessons.body:
## W09 — Electronic record and recovery

Input: three actual indications use S2 but one row defaults to S1; five specimens before verification failure, three repeated. Worked: fix setup link, preserve original record; two specimens unresolved absent valid disposition. Changed: export clips limitations. Repair and inspect the exported document itself. Learner enters and exports a genuine training report and performs actual controlled check/recovery work. A save message is insufficient evidence.

lessons.title: W10 — Integrated scoring and award
lessons.body:
## W10 — Integrated scoring and award

Input: 11/12 detections, one false call in 24 sound regions; one of four bars lacks a valid value. Worked: 91.6667% detection, 4.1667% false-call rate, but incomplete height requirement prevents practical pass. Changed: changed set passes every announced category after remediation. Record actual evidence and training completion, retaining failed history. Written pass or strong detection never offsets missing sizing/coverage. Instructor checks all denominators and the precise demonstrated scope.

lessons.title: Stations and rubric
lessons.body:
## Stations and rubric

Each station: five dimensions scored 0–2—identity/basis, valid setup/method, interpretation/calculation, safe authority-bound action, traceable record. Pass 8/10, no zero, no critical issue. Critical: unsafe handling, fabricated examination, hidden failed checks, unscanned scope claimed complete, unauthorized production release. Stop unsafe activity, teach cause and reobserve changed work. Arithmetic tolerance 0.01 stated unit/percentage point; physical criteria and prior decision rule are separate, without rounding into a pass.

| Station | Evidence | Changed task |
|---|---|---|
| P01 | Complete output/evidence matrix | Missing bar/access |
| P02 **actual** | Identity and safe readiness | Conflicting labels/rolling pipe |
| P03 **actual** | Actual configuration and setup links | Wedge replacement |
| P04 **actual** | Single/dual mode/range verification | Thin-reference failure |
| P05 **actual** | Velocity/zero/path calibration | Included delay |
| P06 **actual** | Index/angle/coordinate verification | Signed index error |
| P07 | Leg and curved-geometry reasoning | Invalid flat approximation |
| P08 **actual** | Reference/scanning/evaluation record | Undocumented gain |
| P09 **actual** | Full directional/contact coverage | Interrupted interval |
| P10 **actual** | Geometry versus indication evidence | Distinct extra response |
| P11 **actual** | Connection/type characterization | Conflicting observations |
| P12 **actual** | Measured endpoints/length | Revised endpoint |
| P13 | Height/depth/ligament/local-thickness calculation | Changed local thickness |
| P14 **actual** | Corroborated tip response | Ambiguous candidate |
| P15 **actual** | Full-feature maximum-height map | Geometric candidate excluded |
| P16 | Reporting-rule interpretation | Inclusive/exclusive boundary |
| P17 **actual** | Actual form entry/export inspection | Wrong setup/hidden limit |
| P18 **actual** | Verification failure/recovery | Partial repeat work |
| P19 | Independent score/denominator analysis | Good detection, missing sizing |
| P20 **actual** | Unseen practice/report and handover | Changed specimen set |

lessons.title: I63 — Integrated independent examination
lessons.body:
## I63 — Integrated independent examination

Six-hour original practical within integrated block, with breaks/setup planning scheduled separately. Blind A and changed B are distinct, validated and comparable. Learner establishes setup without coaching, examines all assigned plate/pipe scope and four bars, records findings/lengths/heights/limits and produces an inspected export. Assessor observes genuine equipment work and preserves source evidence. Do not reveal known flaw counts or truth during the attempt.

Apply all S63 criteria. For 11 detections, at least 10 correct characterizations (ceiling 9.9); for 12 detections, at least 11 (ceiling 10.8). All critical planar features must be found. Every detected feature must meet position/endpoint requirements; all four heights must meet their band. No missing required value can be removed from denominator. Completeness, valid calibration and integrity are independent pass conditions.

Protected truth form: set/version___ alias/region___ flaw/sound/critical___ independent type/connection/location/endpoints/height___ uncertainty___ validated method/reportability___ learner actual result___ signed errors___ decision rule___ category scores___ setup/coverage/source links___ assessor/date___ . Actual hardware validation precedes delivery; no invented data may fill this form.

lessons.title: Final, remediation and credential
lessons.body:
## Final, remediation and credential

20 cases×3 decisions×2 points=120. Three-hour written final in final/review block. Pass 96/120 and 4/6 each domain, no critical error. Calculator/coursebook allowed; keys/collaboration/outside assistance prohibited. Score each decision 2 correct supported, 1 safe incomplete, 0 wrong/missing/unsafe. Changed Form B contains original factual context without answers and changed decisions. Keys/truth remain outside learner distribution; folder separation alone is not software access control.

Require 20 chapters/40 explained checks, 10 labs, 20 stations including 15 actual, I63 and final. Written success cannot replace performance. Diagnose cause, teach, obtain corrected reasoning and changed observed task. After two unsuccessful changed attempts, individualized instruction plus fresh equivalent supervised assessment. Preserve history and allow another competent assessor to review disputes. Missing validated equipment/truth leaves practical pending.

Award “VNDRLY/U Manual Ultrasonic Examination — Integrated Weld Assessment: training assessment completion.” Record learner/prerequisites, actual hours, version/hash, technique/equipment, specimen-set version, category results, remediation, assessor and scope. No API/ASNT/employer credential, production release or other imaging qualification conferred. VNDRLY internal review 24 months or earlier after changed method/requirements or competence concerns; not an external credential term.

lessons.title: Record forms
lessons.body:
## Record forms

**Plan/readiness:** identity/date___ assigned outputs___ geometry/material___ actual safe arrangement___ procedure/revision___ equipment/software___ setup IDs___ references/checks___ directions/limits___ reporting rule___

**Finding:** alias/datum___ setup/calibration link___ actual response/level___ type/connection evidence___ start/stop/length/units___ height/local thickness/tip evidence where assigned___ coverage/limits___ raw record___

**Recovery/export:** last valid___ change/failure___ affected IDs___ actual repeats/disposition___ original retained___ exported version___ rows/units/limits visually checked___ recipient/scope___

**Assessment:** attempt/version___ actual observations___ category denominators/results___ critical issue___ instruction___ changed set/task___ result___ assessor/date___ appeal___ award or pending reason___


---

courses.title: VUC063 | VUC063 formative checks

content.title: VUC063 | VUC063 formative checks
content.description: Course completion records study only. Certification also requires the separately controlled examination and applicable observed assessments specified in the program. This VNDRLY/U curriculum counterpart does not award, replace, or claim accreditation by the external credential issuer.

lessons.title: VUC063 formative checks
lessons.body:
# VUC063 formative checks

Attempt before reading the explanation. Correct errors and revisit the matching chapter/station. These are not the controlled final.

lessons.title: Q01-L1
lessons.body:
## Q01-L1

Does detection alone finish an assignment requiring sizing?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Every assigned output needs evidence. Revisit Q01 and perform its changed application.

lessons.title: Q01-L2
lessons.body:
## Q01-L2

May an inaccessible required bar receive an assumed zero?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Keep measurement pending. Revisit Q01 and perform its changed application.

lessons.title: Q02-L1
lessons.body:
## Q02-L1

May conflicting specimen labels be guessed?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Resolve identity first. Revisit Q02 and perform its changed application.

lessons.title: Q02-L2
lessons.body:
## Q02-L2

Does correct identity excuse unsafe support?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Physical safety independent. Revisit Q02 and perform its changed application.

lessons.title: Q03-L1
lessons.body:
## Q03-L1

Does a saved setup prove current hardware matches?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Verify actual configuration. Revisit Q03 and perform its changed application.

lessons.title: Q03-L2
lessons.body:
## Q03-L2

Must findings link to actual setup?

**Answer:** Yes.

**Reason/remediation:** Traceability supports interpretation/recovery. Revisit Q03 and perform its changed application.

lessons.title: Q04-L1
lessons.body:
## Q04-L1

Can thick-reference success prove thin dual-probe accuracy?

**Answer:** No.

**Reason/remediation:** Verify actual range/nonlinearity. Revisit Q04 and perform its changed application.

lessons.title: Q04-L2

Is reporting every echo as a crack a competent strategy?

lessons.title: VUC063 sources and outcome mapping
lessons.body:
# VUC063 sources and outcome mapping

Reviewed 2026-11-18. Original available-source materials; no complete proprietary-standard or external certification equivalence claimed.

**S63-01 Current manual scope and conflicts.** [API QUTE(M) program page](https://www.api.org/products-and-services/individual-certification-programs/certifications/api-qute-m) and its linked [candidate orientation, effective July2024](https://apidam.widen.net/content/rf1xwwyo2s/pdf/=c&quality=80&x.app=portals). Supports conventional single/dual-element practical examination, integrated reporting and separate method identities. Introductory phased-array wording conflicts with conventional-method wording; height instructions also conflict between adjacent paragraphs. This course discloses that uncertainty and supplies independent explicit training rules, rather than claiming resolution of current API exam policy. External candidates must obtain controlling clarification from API. No old approximate scoring percentages are adopted.

**S63-02 Dual-probe range.** [Evident dual-element setup](https://ims.evidentscientific.com/en/learn/ndt-tutorials/flaw-detection/dual-element-setup). Supports awareness of V-path/nonlinearity and appropriate range checks. No universal probe correction or product performance is claimed; use actual approved instrument/probe method.

**S63-03 Calibration distinctions.** [Evident calibration concepts](https://ims.evidentscientific.com/en/learn/ndt-tutorials/flaw-detection/calibration-concepts). Supports separating setup velocity/zero, reference calibration and periodic instrument certification. Original calculations are simple stated-geometry examples, not device operating instructions.

**S63-04 Tip interpretation.** [Evident tip diffraction](https://ims.evidentscientific.com/en/learn/ndt-tutorials/flaw-detection/tip-diffraction). Supports locating a tip from a demonstrated response/geometry. Does not justify treating every weak echo as a tip or confer TOFD competence.

The linked [API program report/procedure appendix](https://apidam.widen.net/content/uuowohg1wd/pdf/=c&quality=80&x.app=portals) was consulted for reporting/technique context only. This course does not reproduce its technical procedure, forms or proprietary acceptance limits. Equipment-specific validated technique remains required for delivery. All scenarios and S63 grading/specimen specifications are original VNDRLY designs.

| Outcomes | Chapters | Labs | Stations | Final/changed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Integrated scope/readiness | Q01–02 | W01 | P01–02 | Q01–02 F/R |
| Configuration/probe mode | Q03–04 | W02 | P03–04 | Q03–04 F/R |
| Path/index/coordinates | Q05–06 | W03 | P05–06 | Q05–06 F/R |
| Leg/sensitivity | Q07–08 | W04 | P07–08 | Q07–08 F/R |
| Coverage/discrimination | Q09–10 | W05 | P09–10 | Q09–10 F/R |
| Characterization/endpoints | Q11–12 | W06 | P11–12 | Q11–12 F/R |
| Height/tip evidence | Q13–14 | W07 | P13–14 | Q13–14 F/R |
| Maximum/reporting rules | Q15–16 | W08 | P15–16 | Q15–16 F/R |
| Electronic records/recovery | Q17–18 | W09 | P17–18 | Q17–18 F/R |
| Integrated assessment/award | Q19–20 | W10 | P19–20/I63 | Q19–20 F/R |

Two explained checks per chapter. Fifteen actual stations and blind I63 require genuine equipment performance, validated specimens and protected truth. This package supplies design, controls, forms and remediation; it does not fabricate learner completion or claim physical specimens already exist.
